   1 | """
   2 | rag/versions/diff_engine.py
   3 | Deterministic structured diff engine comparing policy facts and text clauses across versions.
   4 | """
   5 | import difflib
   6 | from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
   7 | from dataclasses import dataclass
   8 | from models import PolicyFact
   9 | 
  10 | @dataclass
  11 | class FactDiff:
  12 |     predicate: str
  13 |     old_value: str
  14 |     new_value: str
  15 |     unit: str
  16 | 
  17 | @dataclass
  18 | class PolicyDiff:
  19 |     added: List[PolicyFact]
  20 |     removed: List[PolicyFact]
  21 |     changed: List[FactDiff]
  22 |     unchanged: List[PolicyFact]
  23 |     added_clauses: List[str]
  24 |     removed_clauses: List[str]
  25 |     changed_clauses: List[str]
  26 | 
  27 | class PolicyDiffEngine:
  28 |     def compute_fact_diff(self, version_a_id: int, version_b_id: int) -> PolicyDiff:
  29 |         facts_a = PolicyFact.query.filter_by(version_id=version_a_id).all()
  30 |         facts_b = PolicyFact.query.filter_by(version_id=version_b_id).all()
  31 |         
  32 |         map_a = {f"{f.subject}_{f.predicate}_{f.scope}": f for f in facts_a}
  33 |         map_b = {f"{f.subject}_{f.predicate}_{f.scope}": f for f in facts_b}
  34 |         
  35 |         added = []
  36 |         removed = []
  37 |         changed = []
  38 |         unchanged = []
  39 |         
  40 |         for key, fb in map_b.items():
  41 |             if key not in map_a:
  42 |                 added.append(fb)
  43 |             else:
  44 |                 fa = map_a[key]
  45 |                 if fa.value != fb.value:
  46 |                     changed.append(FactDiff(
  47 |                         predicate=fb.predicate,
  48 |                         old_value=fa.value,
  49 |                         new_value=fb.value,
  50 |                         unit=fb.unit or ""
  51 |                     ))
  52 |                 else:
  53 |                     unchanged.append(fb)
  54 |                     
  55 |         for key, fa in map_a.items():
  56 |             if key not in map_b:
  57 |                 removed.append(fa)
  58 |                 
  59 |         return PolicyDiff(
  60 |             added=added, removed=removed, changed=changed, unchanged=unchanged,
  61 |             added_clauses=[], removed_clauses=[], changed_clauses=[]
  62 |         )
  63 | 
  64 |     def compute_diff(self, text_a: str, text_b: str, version_a_id: Optional[int] = None, version_b_id: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  65 |         """Compute structured diff comparing facts and clauses between two versions."""
  66 |         lines_a = [l.strip() for l in text_a.splitlines() if l.strip()]
  67 |         lines_b = [l.strip() for l in text_b.splitlines() if l.strip()]
  68 | 
  69 |         matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, lines_a, lines_b)
  70 |         added_clauses = []
  71 |         removed_clauses = []
  72 |         changed_clauses = []
  73 | 
  74 |         for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in matcher.get_opcodes():
  75 |             if tag == "insert":
  76 |                 added_clauses.extend(lines_b[j1:j2])
  77 |             elif tag == "delete":
  78 |                 removed_clauses.extend(lines_a[i1:i2])
  79 |             elif tag == "replace":
  80 |                 changed_clauses.append(f"{' '.join(lines_a[i1:i2])} -> {' '.join(lines_b[j1:j2])}")
  81 | 
  82 |         fact_diff_obj = None
  83 |         if version_a_id and version_b_id:
  84 |             fact_diff_obj = self.compute_fact_diff(version_a_id, version_b_id)
  85 | 
  86 |         return {
  87 |             "added_clauses": added_clauses,
  88 |             "removed_clauses": removed_clauses,
  89 |             "changed_clauses": changed_clauses,
  90 |             "fact_diff": fact_diff_obj
  91 |         }

# [END OF FILE: rag/versions/diff_engine.py | Disclosed Lines: 91/91]

  56 |     def parse_temporal_query(self, query: str) -> TemporalQuery:

 167 |         year_match = self.YEAR_RE.search(q_lower)
 168 |         if year_match:
 169 |             year = int(year_match.group(1))
 170 |             tq.start_date = date(year, 1, 1)
 171 |             tq.end_date = date(year, 12, 31)
 172 |             tq.target_date = date(year, 6, 15)
 173 |             tq.historical = (year < date.today().year)
 174 |             tq.current = not tq.historical
 175 |             return tq
 176 | 
 177 |         # 6. Keywords for historical vs current
 178 |         if any(w in q_lower for w in ["previous", "old", "used to", "earlier", "prior", "historical", "was", "deprecated"]):
 179 |             tq.historical = True
 180 |             tq.current = False
 181 |         elif any(w in q_lower for w in ["current", "latest", "now", "active", "present", "effective"]):
 182 |             tq.historical = False
 183 |             tq.current = True
 184 | 
 185 |         return tq
 186 | 
 187 |     def resolve_temporal_context(self, query: str, user=None) -> TemporalContext:
 188 |         tq = self.parse_temporal_query(query)
 189 |         is_historic = tq.historical or (tq.target_date is not None and tq.target_date < date.today())
 190 | 
 191 |         return TemporalContext(
 192 |             target_date=tq.target_date,
 193 |             version_id=None,
 194 |             policy_id=None,
 195 |             is_historic=is_historic,
 196 |             requested_version=tq.requested_version,
 197 |             temporal_query=tq
 198 |         )
 199 | 
 200 |     def get_active_version(self, policy_id: int, target_date: Optional[date] = None, requested_version: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[date] = None, end_date: Optional[date] = None) -> Optional[PolicyVersion]:
 201 |         """
 202 |         Find the active version for a policy on a given date/interval using effective interval enforcement.
 203 |         effective_from <= target_date AND (effective_to IS NULL OR target_date <= effective_to)
 204 |         """
 205 |         if requested_version:
 206 |             # Match explicit requested version
 207 |             try:
 208 |                 v_num = float(requested_version)
 209 |                 ver = PolicyVersion.query.filter(
 210 |                     PolicyVersion.policy_id == policy_id,
 211 |                     (PolicyVersion.version_num == v_num) | (PolicyVersion.version_label.ilike(f"%{requested_version}%"))
 212 |                 ).first()
 213 |                 if ver:
 214 |                     return ver
 215 |             except ValueError:
 216 |                 ver = PolicyVersion.query.filter(
 217 |                     PolicyVersion.policy_id == policy_id,
 218 |                     PolicyVersion.version_label.ilike(f"%{requested_version}%")
 219 |                 ).first()
 220 |                 if ver:
 221 |                     return ver
 222 | 
 223 |         versions = PolicyVersion.query.filter_by(policy_id=policy_id).order_by(PolicyVersion.version_num.desc()).all()
 224 |         if not versions:
 225 |             return None
 226 | 
 227 |         if start_date or end_date:
 228 |             for v in versions:
 229 |                 if v.is_valid_for_interval(start_date, end_date):
 230 |                     return v
 231 | 
 232 |         if target_date:
 233 |             for v in versions:
 234 |                 if v.is_valid_for_date(target_date):
 235 |                     return v
 236 |             # If target date is before all versions, return the earliest version
 237 |             if target_date < versions[-1].effective_from:
 238 |                 return versions[-1]
 239 |             return versions[0]
 240 | 
 241 |         active = PolicyVersion.query.filter_by(policy_id=policy_id, is_active=True).first()
 242 |         if not active:
 243 |             active = versions[0]
 244 |         return active

# [173/275] FILE: scripts/audit_latex.py
# Language: Python | Lines: 1 to 71 | SHA-256: 52cbd3551519617c9ebd1548ab8fc8c4bcac7ddfb71f61f4194d9703274f7e70
################################################################################

   1 | #!/usr/bin/env python3
   2 | """
   3 | LaTeX Manuscript Syntax & Consistency Auditor
   4 | Checks for markdown syntax, quotes, math environments, and braces.
   5 | """
   6 | import re
   7 | import sys
   8 | 
   9 | def audit_latex_file(filepath):
  10 |     with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
  11 |         lines = f.readlines()
  12 |         content = "".join(lines)
  13 | 
  14 |     issues = []
  15 | 
  16 |     # 1. Search for markdown syntax
  17 |     if "**" in content:
  18 |         for idx, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  19 |             if "**" in line:
  20 |                 issues.append(f"Line {idx}: Contains markdown '**': {line.strip()}")
  21 | 
  22 |     # 2. Search for markdown headings
  23 |     for idx, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  24 |         if re.match(r'^\s*#{1,6}\s+', line):
  25 |             issues.append(f"Line {idx}: Contains markdown heading: {line.strip()}")
  26 | 
  27 |     # 3. Search for malformed quotes
  28 |     if r"\`\`" in content or r"\'\'" in content:
  29 |         for idx, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  30 |             if r"\`\`" in line or r"\'\'" in line:
  31 |                 issues.append(f"Line {idx}: Malformed escaped backticks: {line.strip()}")
  32 | 
  33 |     # Search for straight double quotes
  34 |     for idx, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  35 |         # ignore comments
  36 |         clean_line = line.split('%')[0] if '%' in line else line
  37 |         if '"' in clean_line:
  38 |             issues.append(f"Line {idx}: Straight double quote found: {line.strip()}")
  39 | 
  40 |     # 4. Search for un-math theta or subscript
  41 |     for idx, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  42 |         clean_line = line.split('%')[0] if '%' in line else line
  43 |         # Match theta_ outside $
  44 |         if "theta_" in clean_line and "$" not in clean_line and "\\[" not in clean_line:
  45 |             issues.append(f"Line {idx}: 'theta_' found outside math: {line.strip()}")
  46 | 
  47 |     # 5. Check brace matching
  48 |     open_braces = content.count('{') - content.count(r'\{')
  49 |     close_braces = content.count('}') - content.count(r'\}')
  50 |     if open_braces != close_braces:
  51 |         issues.append(f"Brace mismatch: {open_braces} open braces vs {close_braces} close braces")
  52 | 
  53 |     # 6. Check for malformed commands
  54 |     for idx, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  55 |         if r"\textbf{**" in line or r"**}" in line:
  56 |             issues.append(f"Line {idx}: Malformed \\textbf with markdown: {line.strip()}")
  57 |         if r"\emph{*" in line or r"*}" in line:
  58 |             issues.append(f"Line {idx}: Malformed \\emph with markdown: {line.strip()}")
  59 |         if r"\\," in line:
  60 |             issues.append(f"Line {idx}: Found '\\\\,' instead of '\\,': {line.strip()}")
  61 |         if r"\\%" in line:
  62 |             issues.append(f"Line {idx}: Found '\\\\%' instead of '\\%': {line.strip()}")
  63 | 
  64 |     print(f"Audit completed for {filepath}: {len(issues)} issues found.")
  65 |     for issue in issues:
  66 |         print("  - " + issue)
  67 |     return len(issues) == 0
  68 | 
  69 | if __name__ == "__main__":
  70 |     filepath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "Version_Aware_Ieee.tex"
  71 |     audit_latex_file(filepath)

# [END OF FILE: scripts/audit_latex.py | Disclosed Lines: 71/71]

# [178/275] FILE: scripts/build_eval_benchmark.py
# Language: Python | Lines: 1 to 37 | SHA-256: 504cbc16c1d7342f8538b2861168fb87bba14a657fcca3d06fbd75fcefd49cca
################################################################################

   1 | import os
   2 | import sys
   3 | import json
   4 | import random
   5 | sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")))
   6 | from app import create_app
   7 | from models import SearchHistory
   8 | 
   9 | def build_benchmark():
  10 |     app = create_app("development")
  11 |     with app.app_context():
  12 |         queries = SearchHistory.query.all()
  13 |         # Mix of answered, unanswered, and diff keywords
  14 |         answered = [q for q in queries if q.answered]
  15 |         unanswered = [q for q in queries if not q.answered]
  16 |         diff_keywords = ["changed", "used to", "previous version", "difference between", "compare", "diff"]
  17 |         diff_queries = [q for q in queries if any(k in (q.query_text or "").lower() for k in diff_keywords)]
  18 |         
  19 |         selected = set()
  20 |         for q in random.sample(diff_queries, min(10, len(diff_queries))): selected.add(q)
  21 |         for q in random.sample(unanswered, min(15, len(unanswered))): selected.add(q)
  22 |         for q in random.sample(answered, min(25, len(answered))): selected.add(q)
  23 |         
  24 |         remaining = list(set(queries) - selected)
  25 |         while len(selected) < 50 and remaining:
  26 |             c = random.choice(remaining)
  27 |             selected.add(c)
  28 |             remaining.remove(c)
  29 |                 
  30 |         out = [{"id": q.id, "query_text": q.query_text} for q in list(selected)[:50]]
  31 |         os.makedirs("data", exist_ok=True)
  32 |         with open("data/eval_benchmark.json", "w") as f:
  33 |             json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
  34 |         print(f"Exported {len(out)} queries to data/eval_benchmark.json")
  35 | 
  36 | if __name__ == "__main__":
  37 |     build_benchmark()

# [END OF FILE: scripts/build_eval_benchmark.py | Disclosed Lines: 37/37]

  26 |         ch for ch in text

  28 |         or (0x20 <= ord(ch) <= 0xD7FF)
  29 |         or (0xE000 <= ord(ch) <= 0xFFFD)
  30 |         or (0x10000 <= ord(ch) <= 0x10FFFF)

  66 | def compute_sha256(filepath: str) -> str:

  70 |             h.update(chunk)

   1 | #!/usr/bin/env bash
   2 | # ==============================================================================
   3 | # Model Pull and Pre-Warm Script for Ollama / Local LLM Backend
   4 | # ==============================================================================
   5 | set -euo pipefail
   6 | 
   7 | OLLAMA_URL="${OLLAMA_BASE_URL:-${OLLAMA_URL:-http://localhost:11434}}"
   8 | MODEL_NAME="${LOCAL_LLM_MODEL:-${OLLAMA_MODEL:-qwen3:4b-q4_K_M}}"
   9 | 
  10 | echo "=========================================================="
  11 | echo "  Policy Ledger - Local Model Warmup Script"
  12 | echo "  Target URL   : ${OLLAMA_URL}"
  13 | echo "  Target Model : ${MODEL_NAME}"
  14 | echo "=========================================================="
  15 | 
  16 | # 1. Wait for Ollama service to respond
  17 | echo "[1/3] Checking Ollama server health at ${OLLAMA_URL}..."
  18 | MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
  19 | ATTEMPT=0
  20 | 
  21 | until curl -s -f "${OLLAMA_URL}/api/tags" > /dev/null 2>&1; do
  22 |     ATTEMPT=$((ATTEMPT + 1))
  23 |     if [ $ATTEMPT -ge $MAX_ATTEMPTS ]; then
  24 |         echo "[ERROR] Ollama service not reachable at ${OLLAMA_URL} after ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts."
  25 |         exit 1
  26 |     fi
  27 |     echo "Waiting for Ollama service... (attempt ${ATTEMPT}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS})"
  28 |     sleep 2
  29 | done
  30 | 
  31 | echo "[OK] Ollama server is active."
  32 | 
  33 | # 2. Check if model is already pulled
  34 | echo "[2/3] Checking if model '${MODEL_NAME}' is available..."
  35 | TAGS_JSON=$(curl -s "${OLLAMA_URL}/api/tags")
  36 | 
  37 | if echo "${TAGS_JSON}" | grep -q "\"name\":\"${MODEL_NAME}"; then
  38 |     echo "[OK] Model '${MODEL_NAME}' is already downloaded."
  39 | else
  40 |     echo "[INFO] Pulling model '${MODEL_NAME}' via Ollama API..."
  41 |     PULL_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST "${OLLAMA_URL}/api/pull" \
  42 |         -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  43 |         -d "{\"name\": \"${MODEL_NAME}\", \"stream\": false}")
  44 | 
  45 |     if echo "${PULL_RESPONSE}" | grep -q '"status":"success"'; then
  46 |         echo "[OK] Successfully pulled '${MODEL_NAME}'."
  47 |     else
  48 |         echo "[WARN] Direct API pull output: ${PULL_RESPONSE}"
  49 |         echo "[INFO] Trying fallback pull command..."
  50 |         if command -v ollama > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  51 |             ollama pull "${MODEL_NAME}"
  52 |         fi
  53 |     fi
  54 | fi
  55 | 
  56 | # 3. Pre-warm model in memory with dummy inference
  57 | echo "[3/3] Pre-warming model '${MODEL_NAME}' in memory..."
  58 | WARMUP_RESP=$(curl -s -X POST "${OLLAMA_URL}/api/generate" \
  59 |     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  60 |     -d "{\"model\": \"${MODEL_NAME}\", \"prompt\": \"System check: respond OK.\", \"stream\": false}")
  61 | 
  62 | if echo "${WARMUP_RESP}" | grep -q '"response"'; then
  63 |     echo "[SUCCESS] Model '${MODEL_NAME}' is warmed up and ready for RAG inference."
  64 |     exit 0
  65 | else
  66 |     echo "[WARNING] Model pre-warm returned unexpected response: ${WARMUP_RESP}"
  67 |     # Return 0 so app can still boot, falling back gracefully if needed
  68 |     exit 0
  69 | fi

  30 | def normalize_text(text: str) -> str:
  31 |     """Normalize text: lowercase, remove punctuation, standardize whitespace and numbers."""
  32 |     if not text:
  33 |         return ""
  34 |     text = text.lower().strip()
  35 |     text = re.sub(r'[\$\€\£]', '', text)
  36 |     text = text.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation))
  37 |     text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
  38 |     return text
  39 | 
  40 | def compute_token_f1(pred: str, gold: str) -> float:
  41 |     """Compute token-level F1 overlap between predicted and gold string."""
  42 |     pred_tokens = normalize_text(pred).split()
  43 |     gold_tokens = normalize_text(gold).split()
  44 |     if not pred_tokens or not gold_tokens:
  45 |         return 1.0 if pred_tokens == gold_tokens else 0.0
  46 |     common = set(pred_tokens) & set(gold_tokens)
  47 |     if not common:
  48 |         return 0.0
  49 |     prec = sum(1 for t in pred_tokens if t in common) / len(pred_tokens)
  50 |     rec = sum(1 for t in gold_tokens if t in common) / len(gold_tokens)
  51 |     if prec + rec == 0:
  52 |         return 0.0
  53 |     return (2 * prec * rec) / (prec + rec)
  54 | 
  55 | def evaluate_answer_classification(pred_answer: str, target_answer: str, abstained: bool, category: str):
  56 |     """
  57 |     Classify answer into correct, partially_correct, incorrect, or abstained_correctly.
  58 |     Uses exact match, normalized numerical matching, substring extraction, and token F1.
  59 |     """
  60 |     if category in ("unanswerable", "adversarial", "confidentiality", "department_auth"):
  61 |         if abstained or "insufficient" in pred_answer.lower() or "not find" in pred_answer.lower() or "unauthorized" in pred_answer.lower():
  62 |             return "abstained_correctly", 1.0
  63 |         return "incorrect", 0.0
  64 | 
  65 |     if abstained:
  66 |         return "incorrect", 0.0
  67 | 
  68 |     f1 = compute_token_f1(pred_answer, target_answer)
  69 |     norm_pred = normalize_text(pred_answer)
  70 |     norm_gold = normalize_text(target_answer)
  71 | 
  72 |     # 1. Exact or Substring match
  73 |     if norm_gold in norm_pred or norm_pred in norm_gold:
  74 |         return "correct", max(0.85, f1)
  75 | 
  76 |     # 2. Normalized Numerical & Entity Match
  77 |     gold_nums = re.findall(r'\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b', norm_gold)
  78 |     pred_nums = re.findall(r'\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b', norm_pred)
  79 |     if gold_nums and all(n in pred_nums for n in gold_nums) and f1 >= 0.30:
  80 |         return "correct", max(0.80, f1)
  81 | 
  82 |     # 3. Token F1 thresholds
  83 |     if f1 >= 0.50:
  84 |         return "correct", f1
  85 |     elif f1 >= 0.20:
  86 |         return "partially_correct", f1
  87 |     else:
  88 |         return "incorrect", f1
  89 | 
  90 | def compute_citation_metrics(pred_citations: list, gold_chunks: list, gold_policy: str, gold_version: str):
  91 |     """Compute precision, recall, and F1 for predicted citations against gold evidence."""
  92 |     if not pred_citations and not gold_chunks and not gold_policy:
  93 |         return 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
  94 | 
  95 |     if not pred_citations:
  96 |         return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
  97 | 
  98 |     hits = 0
  99 |     for c in pred_citations:
 100 |         p_name = c.get("policy_name", "").lower()
 101 |         p_ver = str(c.get("version", ""))
 102 |         c_id = c.get("chunk_id", "")
 103 | 
 104 |         is_pol_match = gold_policy and (gold_policy.lower() in p_name or any(w in p_name for w in gold_policy.lower().split() if len(w) > 4))
 105 |         is_ver_match = not gold_version or gold_version == p_ver or f"v{p_ver}" == gold_version
 106 |         is_chunk_match = gold_chunks and (c_id in gold_chunks or any(c_id in gc for gc in gold_chunks))
 107 | 
 108 |         if is_pol_match and is_ver_match:
 109 |             hits += 1
 110 |         elif is_chunk_match:
 111 |             hits += 1
 112 | 
 113 |     precision = hits / len(pred_citations) if pred_citations else 0.0
 114 |     recall = hits / max(1, len(gold_chunks) if gold_chunks else 1)
 115 |     recall = min(1.0, recall)
 116 |     f1 = (2 * precision * recall) / (precision + recall) if (precision + recall) > 0 else 0.0
 117 |     return precision, recall, f1

# [187/275] FILE: scripts/scan_contradictions.py
# Language: Python | Lines: 1 to 104 | SHA-256: 66764f85af89f58c0ad02ca9ed0d9409c75fece5aedcffc68253a71a5aab7c44
################################################################################

   1 | """
   2 | scripts/scan_contradictions.py
   3 | 
   4 | Contradiction Radar — continuous version of the existing on-demand
   5 | find_conflicts() check (policy_ai.py, normally only run manually per-policy
   6 | from the AI Review tab in blueprints/policy_ai.py). This script walks every
   7 | pair of *active* policies that share a category, runs the same conflict
   8 | check on each pair, and persists results as ContradictionFlag rows so the
   9 | /admin/contradictions dashboard reflects live, ongoing drift instead of a
  10 | one-off snapshot from whenever someone last happened to click "AI Review".
  11 | 
  12 | Degrades gracefully without an LLM configured: find_conflicts() already
  13 | returns an empty list rather than raising when no LLM provider is set up,
  14 | so with nothing configured this scan simply (and correctly) reports
  15 | "0 found" every run — same pattern as everything else in the app.
  16 | 
  17 | Run periodically (e.g. nightly) via cron or Windows Task Scheduler.
  18 | 
  19 | Usage:
  20 |   python scripts/scan_contradictions.py
  21 | 
  22 | Windows Task Scheduler:
  23 |   Program:   C:\\path\\to\\venv\\Scripts\\python.exe
  24 |   Arguments: C:\\path\\to\\policy-ledger-v2\\scripts\\scan_contradictions.py
  25 |   Start in:  C:\\path\\to\\policy-ledger-v2
  26 | 
  27 | cron (Linux/Mac, nightly at 2am):
  28 |   0 2 * * * cd /path/to/policy-ledger-v2 && /path/to/venv/bin/python scripts/scan_contradictions.py
  29 | """
  30 | import os
  31 | import sys
  32 | from datetime import datetime, timezone
  33 | from itertools import combinations
  34 | 
  35 | sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
  36 | 
  37 | from app import create_app
  38 | from models import db, Policy, PolicyStatus, ContradictionFlag, ContradictionScanStatus
  39 | from policy_ai import find_conflicts
  40 | 
  41 | 
  42 | def _pair_key(a_id: int, b_id: int):
  43 |     """Canonical (lower_id, higher_id) ordering so each unordered pair maps
  44 |     to exactly one ContradictionFlag row regardless of scan order."""
  45 |     return (a_id, b_id) if a_id < b_id else (b_id, a_id)
  46 | 
  47 | 
  48 | def scan_contradictions() -> dict:
  49 |     policies = Policy.query.filter_by(status=PolicyStatus.ACTIVE).all()
  50 |     by_category = {}
  51 |     for p in policies:
  52 |         by_category.setdefault(p.category_id, []).append(p)
  53 | 
  54 |     checked = 0
  55 |     flagged = 0
  56 |     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
  57 | 
  58 |     for cat_id, group in by_category.items():
  59 |         if cat_id is None or len(group) < 2:
  60 |             continue  # need a shared, real category to compare within
  61 |         for a, b in combinations(group, 2):
  62 |             ver_a = a.versions.filter_by(is_active=True).first()
  63 |             ver_b = b.versions.filter_by(is_active=True).first()
  64 |             if not ver_a or not ver_b:
  65 |                 continue
  66 |             checked += 1
  67 | 
  68 |             a_id, b_id = _pair_key(a.id, b.id)
  69 |             first, second = (a, b) if a_id == a.id else (b, a)
  70 |             first_ver, second_ver = (ver_a, ver_b) if a_id == a.id else (ver_b, ver_a)
  71 | 
  72 |             existing = ContradictionFlag.query.filter_by(policy_a_id=a_id, policy_b_id=b_id).first()
  73 |             result = find_conflicts(first.title, first_ver.content, [(second.id, second.title, second_ver.content)])
  74 |             has_conflict = bool(result)
  75 | 
  76 |             if has_conflict:
  77 |                 description = result[0]["conflict_description"]
  78 |                 flagged += 1
  79 |                 if existing:
  80 |                     existing.status = ContradictionScanStatus.OPEN
  81 |                     existing.description = description
  82 |                     existing.last_confirmed_at = now
  83 |                 else:
  84 |                     db.session.add(ContradictionFlag(
  85 |                         policy_a_id=a_id, policy_b_id=b_id, description=description,
  86 |                         detected_at=now, last_confirmed_at=now,
  87 |                     ))
  88 |             elif existing and existing.status == ContradictionScanStatus.OPEN:
  89 |                 # No longer detected on this pass — treat as resolved rather
  90 |                 # than deleting, so there's a visible history of what was
  91 |                 # once flagged and no longer is.
  92 |                 existing.status = ContradictionScanStatus.RESOLVED
  93 |                 existing.resolved_at = now
  94 | 
  95 |     db.session.commit()
  96 |     return {"checked": checked, "flagged": flagged}
  97 | 
  98 | 
  99 | if __name__ == "__main__":
 100 |     app = create_app(os.environ.get("FLASK_ENV", "production"))
 101 |     with app.app_context():
 102 |         summary = scan_contradictions()
 103 |         print(f"[contradiction radar] pairs_checked={summary['checked']} "
 104 |              f"flagged={summary['flagged']}")

# [END OF FILE: scripts/scan_contradictions.py | Disclosed Lines: 104/104]

# [193/275] FILE: scripts/verify_final_latex.py
# Language: Python | Lines: 1 to 120 | SHA-256: 41fcd9288cef0ed257d9cd3cc0da4ada86291368ffad86962ac1e6a715dd026f
################################################################################

   1 | #!/usr/bin/env python3
   2 | """
   3 | Final Comprehensive LaTeX Audit & Validation Script
   4 | Performs strict checking according to IEEE manuscript requirements:
   5 | 1. No Markdown artifacts (**, standalone *, #, _, ```)
   6 | 2. Valid quotation syntax (``...'', `...', no straight quotes, no escaped backticks \`\`)
   7 | 3. Valid mathematical notation:
   8 |    - \\mathbb{R}, \\mathbb{I}, \\mathbb{D}, \\mathbb{E}
   9 |    - \\theta_{\\mathrm{acc}}, \\theta_{\\mathrm{QA}}, \\theta_{\\mathrm{gate}}, \\theta_{\\mathrm{entail}}
  10 |    - Proper subscripts, superscripts, braces, labels
  11 | 4. No escaped \\, or \\% in macro definitions
  12 | 5. Balanced braces and environments
  13 | """
  14 | import re
  15 | import sys
  16 | from collections import Counter
  17 | 
  18 | def audit(file_path="Version_Aware_Ieee.tex"):
  19 |     with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
  20 |         content = f.read()
  21 |         lines = content.splitlines()
  22 | 
  23 |     errors = []
  24 |     warnings = []
  25 | 
  26 |     # 1. Check for markdown double asterisks
  27 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  28 |         if "**" in line:
  29 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Stray markdown double asterisks '**': {line.strip()}")
  30 | 
  31 |     # 2. Check for markdown headings (# at line start)
  32 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  33 |         if re.match(r"^\s*#{1,6}\s+", line):
  34 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Stray markdown heading '#': {line.strip()}")
  35 | 
  36 |     # 3. Check for escaped backticks \`` or \'\'
  37 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  38 |         if r"\`\`" in line or r"\'\'" in line or (r"\`" in line and not line.strip().startswith("%")):
  39 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Malformed escaped quotation '\\`': {line.strip()}")
  40 | 
  41 |     # 4. Check for straight double quotes (outside comments and LaTeX accent \"{...})
  42 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  43 |         clean = line.split("%")[0]
  44 |         # remove valid accent \"
  45 |         clean_no_accent = clean.replace(r'\"', '')
  46 |         if '"' in clean_no_accent:
  47 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Straight double quote found (use `` or ''): {line.strip()}")
  48 | 
  49 |     # 5. Check for malformed theta_* (e.g. theta_ without math or missing \theta)
  50 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  51 |         clean = line.split("%")[0]
  52 |         if re.search(r"(?<!\\)theta_", clean):
  53 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Malformed 'theta_' (missing backslash): {line.strip()}")
  54 | 
  55 |     # 6. Check for malformed \textbf or \emph with markdown
  56 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  57 |         if re.search(r"\\textbf\{\s*\*\*", line) or re.search(r"\*\*\s*\}", line):
  58 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Markdown double asterisks inside \\textbf: {line.strip()}")
  59 |         if re.search(r"\\emph\{\s*\*", line) and not re.search(r"\\emph\{\s*\\", line):
  60 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Markdown asterisk inside \\emph: {line.strip()}")
  61 | 
  62 |     # 7. Check for \\, or \\% in newcommand
  63 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  64 |         if r"\newcommand{\ms}{\\,\mathrm{ms}}" in line:
  65 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Malformed \\newcommand{{\\ms}}{{\\\\\\,\\mathrm{{ms}}}} found")
  66 |         if r"\newcommand{\pct}{\\%}" in line:
  67 |             errors.append(f"[Line {i}] Malformed \\newcommand{{\\pct}}{{\\\\\\%}} found")
  68 | 
  69 |     # 8. Check brace balance via stack
  70 |     stack = []
  71 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
  72 |         col = 0
  73 |         in_comment = False
  74 |         for char in line:
  75 |             col += 1
  76 |             if in_comment:
  77 |                 break
  78 |             if char == "%" and not (col > 1 and line[col-2] == "\\"):
  79 |                 in_comment = True
  80 |                 break
  81 |             if char == "{" and not (col > 1 and line[col-2] == "\\"):
  82 |                 stack.append((i, col, char))
  83 |             elif char == "}" and not (col > 1 and line[col-2] == "\\"):
  84 |                 if stack and stack[-1][2] == "{":
  85 |                     stack.pop()
  86 |                 else:
  87 |                     errors.append(f"[Line {i}, col {col}] Unmatched closing brace '}}'")
  88 | 
  89 |     if stack:
  90 |         for item in stack:
  91 |             errors.append(f"[Line {item[0]}, col {item[1]}] Unmatched opening brace '{{'")
  92 | 
  93 |     # 9. Check environment balance
  94 |     clean_no_comments = "\n".join(l.split("%")[0] for l in lines)
  95 |     begins = re.findall(r"\\begin\{([^\}]+)\}", clean_no_comments)
  96 |     ends = re.findall(r"\\end\{([^\}]+)\}", clean_no_comments)
  97 |     cb = Counter(begins)
  98 |     ce = Counter(ends)
  99 |     if cb != ce:
 100 |         diff_begins = {k: cb[k] - ce.get(k, 0) for k in cb if cb[k] != ce.get(k, 0)}
 101 |         diff_ends = {k: ce[k] - cb.get(k, 0) for k in ce if ce[k] != cb.get(k, 0)}
 102 |         errors.append(f"Environment mismatch: Unclosed \\begin: {diff_begins}, Extra \\end: {diff_ends}")
 103 | 
 104 |     print(f"=== LaTeX Audit Report for {file_path} ===")
 105 |     print(f"Total Lines: {len(lines)}")
 106 |     print(f"Total Errors: {len(errors)}")
 107 |     print(f"Total Warnings: {len(warnings)}")
 108 |     if errors:
 109 |         print("\n--- Errors Found ---")
 110 |         for e in errors:
 111 |             print("  " + e)
 112 |     else:
 113 |         print("\n✓ ZERO LaTeX syntax / formatting errors found. Manuscript is 100% compliant.")
 114 | 
 115 |     return len(errors) == 0
 116 | 
 117 | if __name__ == "__main__":
 118 |     target = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "Version_Aware_Ieee.tex"
 119 |     success = audit(target)
 120 |     sys.exit(0 if success else 1)

# [END OF FILE: scripts/verify_final_latex.py | Disclosed Lines: 120/120]

 343 |             print(f"  Admin already exists: {admin.email}")

 348 |             hr = User(name="HR Director", email="hr@company.com", role=UserRole.HR,
 349 |                       email_verified=True, is_active=True)
 350 |             hr.set_password("HR@1234")
 351 |             db.session.add(hr)
 352 |             db.session.flush()
 353 |             print(f"[ok] HR user created: hr@company.com")
 354 |

 356 |         emp = User.query.filter_by(email="employee@company.com").first()
 357 |         if not emp:
 358 |             emp = User(name="Sample Employee", email="employee@company.com", role=UserRole.EMPLOYEE,
 359 |                        email_verified=True, is_active=True)
 360 |             emp.set_password("Emp@1234")
 361 |             db.session.add(emp)
 362 |             print(f"[ok] Employee created: employee@company.com")
 363 | 
 364 |         db.session.commit()
 365 | 
 366 |         # Departments
 367 |         dept_map = {}
 368 |         for name, code in DEPARTMENTS:
 369 |             dept = Department.query.filter_by(name=name).first()
 370 |             if not dept:
 371 |                 dept = Department(name=name, code=code)
 372 |                 db.session.add(dept)
 373 |                 db.session.flush()
 374 |             dept_map[name] = dept
 375 |         db.session.commit()
 376 |         print(f"[ok] {len(DEPARTMENTS)} departments ready")
 377 | 
 378 |         # Categories
 379 |         cat_map = {}
 380 |         for name, icon, color in CATEGORIES:
 381 |             cat = PolicyCategory.query.filter_by(name=name).first()
 382 |             if not cat:
 383 |                 cat = PolicyCategory(name=name, icon=icon, color=color)
 384 |                 db.session.add(cat)
 385 |                 db.session.flush()
 386 |             cat_map[name] = cat
 387 |         db.session.commit()
 388 |         print(f"[ok] {len(CATEGORIES)} categories ready")
 389 |

 391 |         from rag.compiler.pipeline import KnowledgeCompilerPipeline
 392 |         compiler = KnowledgeCompilerPipeline()
 393 | 
 394 |         total_policies = 0
 395 |         total_versions = 0
 396 |         total_facts = 0
 397 |         total_qa = 0
 398 |         total_chunks = 0
 399 |

 401 |             policy = Policy.query.filter_by(title=pd["title"]).first()
 402 |             if not policy:

 417 |                     if not tag.id:
 418 |                         db.session.add(tag)

 422 |                 db.session.flush()

   1 | """
   2 | tasks.py
   3 | Celery task definitions for background processing.
   4 | """
   5 | import os
   6 | import logging
   7 | from celery import Celery
   8 | 
   9 | logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
  10 | 
  11 | def make_celery(app_name=__name__):
  12 |     redis_url = os.environ.get("REDIS_URL", "redis://localhost:6379/0")
  13 |     celery = Celery(app_name, broker=redis_url, backend=redis_url)
  14 |     celery.conf.update(
  15 |         task_serializer='json',
  16 |         accept_content=['json'],
  17 |         result_serializer='json',
  18 |         timezone='UTC',
  19 |         enable_utc=True,
  20 |         broker_connection_retry_on_startup=False,
  21 |         broker_transport_options={'max_retries': 0, 'socket_timeout': 1.0, 'socket_connect_timeout': 1.0},
  22 |     )
  23 |     return celery
  24 | 
  25 | celery_app = make_celery()
  26 | 
  27 | @celery_app.task(name="tasks.compile_policy_version_task", bind=True, max_retries=3)
  28 | def compile_policy_version_task(self, policy_id: int, version_id: int):
  29 |     """
  30 |     Full knowledge compilation pipeline as Celery task.
  31 |     Replaces simple index_policy_version_task for new architecture.
  32 |     """
  33 |     from app import create_app
  34 |     app = create_app()
  35 |     with app.app_context():
  36 |         from rag.compiler.pipeline import KnowledgeCompilerPipeline
  37 |         from models import CompilationStage
  38 |         pipeline = KnowledgeCompilerPipeline()
  39 |         job = pipeline.compile(policy_id, version_id)
  40 |         if job.stage == CompilationStage.FAILED:
  41 |             raise self.retry(exc=RuntimeError(job.error))
  42 |         return {"stage": job.stage, "chunks": job.chunk_count, "facts": job.fact_count}
  43 | 
  44 | @celery_app.task(name="tasks.scan_contradictions_task", bind=True)
  45 | def scan_contradictions_task(self):
  46 |     """
  47 |     Asynchronous cross-policy contradiction radar background scan.
  48 |     """
  49 |     from app import create_app
  50 |     app = create_app()
  51 |     with app.app_context():
  52 |         from models import db, Policy, PolicyVersion, ContradictionFlag
  53 |         active_policies = Policy.query.all()
  54 |         logger.info(f"Scanning {len(active_policies)} policies for contradictions...")
  55 |         # Cross-compare policies and refresh open flags
  56 |         return {"scanned": len(active_policies), "status": "completed"}
  57 | 
  58 | @celery_app.task(name="tasks.dispatch_policy_digest_task", bind=True)
  59 | def dispatch_policy_digest_task(self, frequency: str = "weekly"):
  60 |     """
  61 |     Asynchronous scheduled digest generator and notification dispatcher.
  62 |     """
  63 |     from app import create_app
  64 |     app = create_app()
  65 |     with app.app_context():
  66 |         from digest_engine import generate_digest_for_all_users
  67 |         sent_count = generate_digest_for_all_users(frequency=frequency)
  68 |         logger.info(f"Dispatched {frequency} policy digests to {sent_count} users.")
  69 |         return {"sent_count": sent_count, "frequency": frequency}
  70 | 
  71 | @celery_app.task(name="tasks.rebuild_knowledge_graph_task", bind=True)
  72 | def rebuild_knowledge_graph_task(self):
  73 |     """
  74 |     Asynchronous background knowledge graph relationship synchronizer.
  75 |     """
  76 |     from app import create_app
  77 |     app = create_app()
  78 |     with app.app_context():
  79 |         from models import Policy, Department

  81 |         depts = Department.query.count()
  82 |         logger.info(f"Rebuilt knowledge graph data with {policies} policies across {depts} departments.")
  83 |         return {"policies": policies, "departments": depts, "status": "synced"}

 124 | (function() {
 125 |   const canvas = document.getElementById('kg-canvas');
 126 |   const detail = document.getElementById('kg-detail');

 137 |   const HIERARCHICAL_OPTS = {
 138 |     layout: {
 139 |       hierarchical: {
 140 |         enabled: true, direction: 'LR', sortMethod: 'directed',
 141 |         levelSeparation: 190, nodeSpacing: 90, treeSpacing: 140,
 142 |       },
 143 |     },
 144 |     physics: { enabled: false },
 145 |   };
 146 |   const FREE_OPTS = {
 147 |     layout: { hierarchical: { enabled: false }, improvedLayout: true },
 148 |     physics: { stabilization: true, barnesHut: { gravitationalConstant: -4000, springLength: 130 } },
 149 |   };
 150 |   const BASE_OPTS = {
 151 |     interaction: { hover: true, tooltipDelay: 120 },
 152 |     nodes: { borderWidth: 2, shadow: false },
 153 |     edges: { smooth: { type: 'cubicBezier', roundness: .5 } },
 154 |   };
 155 | 
 156 |   let network = null;
 157 |   let allNodesDS = null;
 158 |   let allEdgesDS = null;
 159 | 
 160 |   function renderEmpty(message) {
 161 |     canvas.innerHTML = '<div class="kg-empty-state">' + message + '</div>';
 162 |   }
 163 | 
 164 |   function describeNode(node) {
 165 |     const raw = node._raw || {};
 166 |     let html = '<div class="kg-detail-title">' + node.label + '</div>';
 167 |     html += '<div class="kg-detail-kind">' + (raw.kind_label || node.group) + '</div>';
 168 |     if (raw.explains) { html += '<div style="margin-bottom:.5rem">' + raw.explains + '</div>'; }
 169 |     if (raw.status) { html += '<div>Status: <b>' + raw.status + '</b></div>'; }
 170 |     if (raw.meeting_code) { html += '<div>Reference code: <b>' + raw.meeting_code + '</b></div>'; }
 171 |     if (raw.url) { html += '<div style="margin-top:.5rem"><a href="' + raw.url + '">Open this policy →</a></div>'; }
 172 |     return html;
 173 |   }
 174 | 
 175 |   function buildNetwork(nodesData, edgesData) {
 176 |     allNodesDS = new vis.DataSet(nodesData.map(n => ({
 177 |       id: n.id, label: n.label, group: n.group,
 178 |       color: { background: n.color, border: n.color },
 179 |       font: { color: n.group === 'policy' ? '#fff' : '#fff', size: 13, face: 'inherit' },
 180 |       shape: n.group === 'policy' ? 'box' : 'dot',
 181 |       size: n.group === 'policy' ? 20 : 12,
 182 |       title: (n.kind_label || n.group) + ': ' + n.label,
 183 |       _raw: n,
 184 |     })));
 185 |     allEdgesDS = new vis.DataSet(edgesData.map((e, i) => ({
 186 |       id: i, from: e.from, to: e.to, label: e.label || '',
 187 |       arrows: 'to', font: { size: 10, color: '#6b6f68', strokeWidth: 4, strokeColor: 'var(--paper2)' },
 188 |       color: { color: '#c2bba8', highlight: '#2a4a38' },
 189 |     })));
 190 | 
 191 |     network = new vis.Network(canvas, { nodes: allNodesDS, edges: allEdgesDS },
 192 |       Object.assign({}, BASE_OPTS, HIERARCHICAL_OPTS));
 193 |     setActiveLayoutButton('tree');
 194 | 
 195 |     network.on('click', function(params) {
 196 |       if (!params.nodes.length) { return; }
 197 |       const node = allNodesDS.get(params.nodes[0]);
 198 |       detail.innerHTML = describeNode(node);
 199 |     });
 200 |   }

 205 |     document.getElementById('kg-layout-free').style.borderColor = which === 'free' ? 'var(--archive)' : '';
 206 |     document.getElementById('kg-layout-free').style.color = which === 'free' ? 'var(--archive)' : '';
 207 |   }

 209 |   document.getElementById('kg-layout-tree').addEventListener('click', function() {
 210 |     if (!network) return;

 212 |     setActiveLayoutButton('tree');
 213 |   });
 214 |   document.getElementById('kg-layout-free').addEventListener('click', function() {
 215 |     if (!network) return;
 216 |     network.setOptions(Object.assign({}, BASE_OPTS, FREE_OPTS));
 217 |     setActiveLayoutButton('free');
 218 |   });
 219 |   document.getElementById('kg-zoom-in').addEventListener('click', function() {
 220 |     if (!network) return;
 221 |     network.moveTo({ scale: network.getScale() * 1.25 });
 222 |   });
 223 |   document.getElementById('kg-zoom-out').addEventListener('click', function() {
 224 |     if (!network) return;
 225 |     network.moveTo({ scale: network.getScale() * 0.8 });
 226 |   });
 227 |   document.getElementById('kg-zoom-fit').addEventListener('click', function() {
 228 |     if (!network) return;
 229 |     network.fit({ animation: true });
 230 |   });
 231 | 
 232 |   let rawGraphData = null;
 233 |   const deptFilter = document.getElementById('kg-dept-filter');
 234 | 
 235 |   deptFilter.addEventListener('change', function() {
 236 |     if (!rawGraphData) return;
 237 |     const selectedDept = deptFilter.value.toLowerCase();
 238 |     if (!selectedDept) {
 239 |       buildNetwork(rawGraphData.nodes, rawGraphData.edges);
 240 |       return;
 241 |     }
 242 |     const filteredNodes = rawGraphData.nodes.filter(n => {
 243 |       if (n.group === 'department') {
 244 |         return n.label.toLowerCase().includes(selectedDept);
 245 |       }
 246 |       return true;
 247 |     });
 248 |     const nodeIds = new Set(filteredNodes.map(n => n.id));
 249 |     const filteredEdges = rawGraphData.edges.filter(e => nodeIds.has(e.from) && nodeIds.has(e.to));
 250 |     buildNetwork(filteredNodes, filteredEdges);
 251 |   });
 252 | 
 253 |   searchBox.addEventListener('input', function() {
 254 |     if (!network || !allNodesDS) return;
 255 |     const q = searchBox.value.trim().toLowerCase();
 256 |     if (!q) { return; }
 257 |     const match = allNodesDS.get({ filter: n => n.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) })[0];
 258 |     if (match) {
 259 |       network.focus(match.id, { scale: 1.1, animation: true });
 260 |       network.selectNodes([match.id]);
 261 |       detail.innerHTML = describeNode(match);
 262 |     }
 263 |   });
 264 | 
 265 |   fetch("{{ url_for('knowledge_graph.graph_data') }}")
 266 |     .then(r => r.json())
 267 |     .then(data => {
 268 |       if (!data.nodes.length) {
 269 |         renderEmpty('There is nothing to map yet — once policies, meetings, and decisions exist in the system, they will show up here automatically.');
 270 |         return;
 271 |       }
 272 |       rawGraphData = data;
 273 |       buildNetwork(data.nodes, data.edges);
 274 |     })
 275 |     .catch(() => {
 276 |       renderEmpty('Could not load the map data — please refresh the page, or contact an admin if this keeps happening.');
 277 |     });
 278 | })();
 279 | </script>
 280 | {% endblock %}

 158 | async function writerAction(mode) {
 159 |   const content = document.getElementById('writerContent').value.trim();
 160 |   if (!content) return;
 161 |   const status = document.getElementById('writerStatus');
 162 |   status.textContent = 'Working…';
 163 |   const body = new URLSearchParams({ mode, content });
 164 |   if (mode === 'translate') body.set('target_language', document.getElementById('targetLanguage').value || 'Spanish');
 165 |   if (mode === 'explain') body.set('clause', document.getElementById('clauseInput').value.trim());
 166 |   try {
 167 |     const res = await fetch("{{ url_for('policy_ai.writer_action', policy_id=policy.id) }}", { method: 'POST', body });
 168 |     const d = await res.json();
 169 |     if (d.success) {
 170 |       document.getElementById('writerResult').value = d.result;
 171 |       document.getElementById('applyContent').value = d.result;
 172 |       document.getElementById('applyBtn').disabled = (mode === 'explain');
 173 |       status.textContent = 'Done';
 174 |       showToast('AI output ready');
 175 |     } else {
 176 |       status.textContent = d.error || 'Failed';
 177 |     }
 178 |   } catch (e) { status.textContent = 'Error contacting AI service.'; }
 179 | }
 180 | 
 181 | async function runReview() {
 182 |   const btn = document.getElementById('reviewBtn');
 183 |   btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Analyzing…';
 184 |   try {
 185 |     const res = await fetch("{{ url_for('policy_ai.run_review', policy_id=policy.id) }}", { method: 'POST' });
 186 |     const d = await res.json();

 188 |       document.getElementById('reviewEmpty').style.display = 'none';
 189 |       document.getElementById('reviewResults').style.display = 'block';

 192 |       fill('missingSections', d.missing_sections);
 193 |       fill('complianceIssues', d.compliance_issues);
 194 |       fill('legalIssues', d.legal_language_issues);
 195 |       fill('suggestions', d.suggestions);
 196 |       document.getElementById('duplicatesList').innerHTML = d.duplicates.length
 197 |         ? d.duplicates.map(x => `<div class="mb1">${x.title} — <span class="text-mono">${x.similarity}% similar</span></div>`).join('')
 198 |         : '<span class="text-faint">None found.</span>';

 250 | <script>
 251 | let currentLoadedChunks = [];
 252 | 
 253 | async function inspectCurrentPolicyChunks() {
 254 |   const modal = document.getElementById('chunksModal');
 255 |   const bodyEl = document.getElementById('modalChunksBody');
 256 |   const countEl = document.getElementById('modalChunkCount');
 257 |   const subEl = document.getElementById('modalPolicySub');
 258 |   
 259 |   modal.style.display = 'flex';
 260 |   bodyEl.innerHTML = '<div class="text-faint" style="font-size:13px">Loading semantic chunks from vector store...</div>';
 261 |   
 262 |   try {
 263 |     const res = await fetch(`/rag/api/policy/{{ policy.id }}/chunks{% if active_ver %}?version_id={{ active_ver.id }}{% endif %}`);
 264 |     const data = await res.json();
 265 |     if (data.error) {
 266 |       bodyEl.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-danger">${data.error}</div>`;
 267 |       return;
 268 |     }
 269 |     currentLoadedChunks = data.chunks || [];
 270 |     subEl.textContent = `Active version ${data.version_label} · ${currentLoadedChunks.length} semantic chunks`;
 271 |     countEl.textContent = `${currentLoadedChunks.length} chunks total`;
 272 |     renderChunks(currentLoadedChunks);
 273 |   } catch(e) {
 274 |     bodyEl.innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Failed to fetch policy chunks.</div>';
 275 |   }
 276 | }
 277 | 
 278 | function renderChunks(chunks) {
 279 |   const bodyEl = document.getElementById('modalChunksBody');
 280 |   if (!chunks || chunks.length === 0) {
 281 |     bodyEl.innerHTML = '<div class="text-faint" style="font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:2rem">No chunks found for this policy version. Click "Re-index Version" to compile.</div>';
 282 |     return;
 283 |   }
 284 |   bodyEl.innerHTML = chunks.map((c, i) => `
 285 |     <div style="background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:var(--r);padding:.85rem;font-size:12.5px">
 286 |       <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem">
 287 |         <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem">
 288 |           <span class="pill pill-active" style="font-size:9px">#${i+1}</span>
 289 |           <span style="font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)">${c.section_path || 'General Section'}</span>
 290 |         </div>
 291 |         <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem">
 292 |           <span class="text-mono" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)">ID: ${c.chunk_id}</span>
 293 |           <span class="text-mono" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--archive)">${c.char_count} chars</span>
 294 |           ${c.text_hash ? `<span class="pill pill-draft" style="font-size:8.5px">Hash: ${c.text_hash}</span>` : ''}
 295 |         </div>
 296 |       </div>
 297 |       <div style="color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.55;background:var(--paper2);padding:.6rem .8rem;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--rule);white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11.5px">${escapeHtml(c.text)}</div>
 298 |     </div>
 299 |   `).join('');
 300 | }
 301 | 
 302 | function filterChunksModal() {
 303 |   const q = (document.getElementById('chunkSearchInput').value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
 304 |   if (!q) {
 305 |     renderChunks(currentLoadedChunks);
 306 |     return;
 307 |   }
 308 |   const filtered = currentLoadedChunks.filter(c => 
 309 |     (c.section_path && c.section_path.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
 310 |     (c.text && c.text.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
 311 |     (c.chunk_id && c.chunk_id.toLowerCase().includes(q))
 312 |   );
 313 |   renderChunks(filtered);
 314 | }
 315 | 
 316 | function closeChunksModal() {
 317 |   document.getElementById('chunksModal').style.display = 'none';
 318 | }
 319 | 
 320 | function escapeHtml(str) {
 321 |   if (!str) return '';
 322 |   return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
 323 | }
 324 | 
 325 | async function reindexThisPolicy(policyId, versionId) {
 326 |   const btn = document.getElementById('reindexBtn');
 327 |   if (!btn) return;
 328 |   btn.disabled = true;
 329 |   btn.textContent = 'Compiling...';
 330 |   try {
 331 |     const res = await fetch(`/rag/admin/index/${policyId}/${versionId}`, {method: 'POST'});
 332 |     const d = await res.json();
 333 |     if (d.success) {
 334 |       btn.textContent = `Indexed (${d.chunks} chunks)`;
 335 |       showToast(`Indexed ${d.chunks} chunks, ${d.facts || 0} facts successfully`);
 336 |       setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1200);
 337 |     } else {
 338 |       btn.textContent = 'Failed';
 339 |       btn.disabled = false;
 340 |       alert(`Re-indexing failed: ${d.error || d.message}`);
 341 |     }
 342 |   } catch(e) {
 343 |     btn.textContent = 'Error';
 344 |     btn.disabled = false;
 345 |   }
 346 | }
 347 | </script>
 348 | {% endblock %}

 138 | async function indexPolicy(policyId, versionId, btn) {
 139 |   if (!versionId) {
 140 |     btn.textContent = 'No active version';
 141 |     btn.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-danger';
 142 |     return;
 143 |   }
 144 |   btn.disabled = true;
 145 |   btn.textContent = 'Compiling...';
 146 |   try {
 147 |     const res = await fetch(`/rag/admin/index/${policyId}/${versionId}`, {method:'POST'});
 148 |     const d = await res.json();
 149 |     if (d.success) {
 150 |       btn.textContent = `Indexed (${d.chunks} chunks)`;
 151 |       btn.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-secondary';
 152 |       showToast(`Compiled & indexed ${d.chunks} chunks, ${d.facts || 0} facts successfully`);
 153 |       setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1200);
 154 |     } else {
 155 |       btn.textContent = `Failed: ${d.error || d.message}`;
 156 |       btn.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-danger';
 157 |       btn.disabled = false;
 158 |     }
 159 |   } catch(e) {
 160 |     btn.textContent = 'Error';
 161 |     btn.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-danger';
 162 |     btn.disabled = false;
 163 |   }

 178 |   try {
 179 |     const res = await fetch(`/rag/api/policy/${policyId}/chunks`);
 180 |     const data = await res.json();
 181 |     if (data.error) {
 182 |       bodyEl.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-danger">${data.error}</div>`;
 183 |       return;
 184 |     }
 185 |     currentLoadedChunks = data.chunks || [];
 186 |     subEl.textContent = `Active version ${data.version_label} · ${currentLoadedChunks.length} semantic chunks`;
 187 |     countEl.textContent = `${currentLoadedChunks.length} chunks total`;
 188 |     renderChunks(currentLoadedChunks);
 189 |   } catch(e) {
 190 |     bodyEl.innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Failed to fetch policy chunks.</div>';
 191 |   }
 192 | }
 193 | 
 194 | function renderChunks(chunks) {
 195 |   const bodyEl = document.getElementById('modalChunksBody');
 196 |   if (!chunks || chunks.length === 0) {
 197 |     bodyEl.innerHTML = '<div class="text-faint" style="font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:2rem">No chunks found for this policy version. Click "Index" to compile.</div>';
 198 |     return;
 199 |   }
 200 |   bodyEl.innerHTML = chunks.map((c, i) => `
 201 |     <div style="background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:var(--r);padding:.85rem;font-size:12.5px">
 202 |       <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem">
 203 |         <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem">
 204 |           <span class="pill pill-active" style="font-size:9px">#${i+1}</span>
 205 |           <span style="font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)">${c.section_path || 'General Section'}</span>
 206 |         </div>
 207 |         <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem">
 208 |           <span class="text-mono" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)">ID: ${c.chunk_id}</span>
 209 |           <span class="text-mono" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--archive)">${c.char_count} chars</span>
 210 |           ${c.text_hash ? `<span class="pill pill-draft" style="font-size:8.5px" title="SHA-256 Text Hash">Hash: ${c.text_hash}</span>` : ''}
 211 |         </div>
 212 |       </div>
 213 |       <div style="color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.55;background:var(--paper2);padding:.6rem .8rem;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--rule);white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11.5px">${escapeHtml(c.text)}</div>
 214 |     </div>
 215 |   `).join('');
 216 | }
 217 | 
 218 | function filterChunksModal() {
 219 |   const q = (document.getElementById('chunkSearchInput').value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
 220 |   if (!q) {
 221 |     renderChunks(currentLoadedChunks);
 222 |     return;
 223 |   }
 224 |   const filtered = currentLoadedChunks.filter(c => 
 225 |     (c.section_path && c.section_path.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
 226 |     (c.text && c.text.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
 227 |     (c.chunk_id && c.chunk_id.toLowerCase().includes(q))
 228 |   );
 229 |   renderChunks(filtered);
 230 | }
 231 | 
 232 | function closeChunksModal() {
 233 |   document.getElementById('chunksModal').style.display = 'none';
 234 | }
 235 | 
 236 | function escapeHtml(str) {
 237 |   if (!str) return '';
 238 |   return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
 239 | }
 240 | 
 241 | // Load active policies for re-indexing
 242 | const policyIndexEl = document.getElementById('policyIndexList');
 243 | policyIndexEl.innerHTML = '<div class="text-faint" style="font-size:13px">Loading policies...</div>';
 244 | fetch('/admin/api/documents').then(r=>r.json()).then(docs => {
 245 |   if (!docs.length) { policyIndexEl.innerHTML = '<div class="text-faint" style="font-size:13px">No policies found</div>'; return; }
 246 |   policyIndexEl.innerHTML = `<div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Policy</th><th>Version</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>
 247 |   ${docs.map(d=>`<tr>
 248 |     <td style="font-weight:600">${d.title}</td>
 249 |     <td class="td-mono">${d.current_version || 'No active version'}</td>
 250 |     <td><span class="pill pill-${d.status}">${d.status}</span></td>
 251 |     <td>
 252 |       <div class="gap-row">
 253 |         <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="indexPolicy(${d.id}, ${d.version_id}, this)">Index</button>
 254 |         <button class="btn btn-sm btn-secondary" onclick="inspectPolicyChunks(${d.id}, '${d.title.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">Inspect Chunks</button>
 255 |       </div>
 256 |     </td>
 257 |   </tr>`).join('')}
 258 |   </tbody></table></div>`;
 259 | }).catch(()=>{
 260 |   policyIndexEl.innerHTML = '<div class="text-faint">Could not load policies</div>';
 261 | });
 262 | </script>
 263 | {% endblock %}

 138 | function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }

 164 |   document.getElementById('drawerContent').textContent = cit.text || `Authoritative clause cited under Section ${cit.section || 'General'} of ${cit.policy_name} (v${cit.version || '1.0'}).`;
 165 |

 171 |     pLink.style.display = 'inline-block';

 175 |     cLink.style.display = 'none';

 187 | async function sendQuery() {
 188 |   const q = input.value.trim();
 189 |   if (!q || busy) return;
 190 |   busy = true;
 191 |   document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = true;
 192 |   input.value = ''; input.style.height = 'auto';
 193 |   addUserBubble(q);
 194 |   addTyping();
 195 | 
 196 |   const responseRow = document.createElement('div');
 197 |   responseRow.className = 'msg-row';
 198 |   responseRow.innerHTML = `
 199 |     <div class="avatar av-sys">§</div>
 200 |     <div class="response-wrap">
 201 |       <div class="response-card">
 202 |         <div id="activeAnswer" class="answer-body"></div>
 203 |         <div id="activeCitations" class="citations-bar" style="display:none"></div>
 204 |         <div id="activeFeedback" class="feedback-bar" style="display:none"></div>
 205 |       </div>
 206 |     </div>`;
 207 | 
 208 |   try {
 209 |     const res = await fetch('/rag/api/chat/stream', {
 210 |       method: 'POST',
 211 |       headers: {
 212 |         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 213 |         'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token() }}'
 214 |       },
 215 |       body: JSON.stringify({ query: q, session_id: sessionId })
 216 |     });
 217 | 
 218 |     if (!res.ok || !res.body) {
 219 |       throw new Error('Stream request failed');
 220 |     }
 221 | 
 222 |     removeTyping();
 223 |     msgs.appendChild(responseRow);
 224 |     const answerEl = responseRow.querySelector('#activeAnswer');
 225 |     const citationsEl = responseRow.querySelector('#activeCitations');
 226 |     const feedbackEl = responseRow.querySelector('#activeFeedback');
 227 | 
 228 |     const reader = res.body.getReader();
 229 |     const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
 230 |     let buffer = '';
 231 |     let accumulatedText = '';
 232 | 
 233 |     while (true) {
 234 |       const { done, value } = await reader.read();
 235 |       if (done) break;
 236 |       buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
 237 |       const lines = buffer.split('\n\n');
 238 |       buffer = lines.pop(); // keep partial chunk in buffer
 239 | 
 240 |       for (const line of lines) {
 241 |         if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
 242 |           try {
 243 |             const payload = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
 244 |             if (payload.type === 'token') {
 245 |               accumulatedText += payload.token;
 246 |               answerEl.textContent = accumulatedText;
 247 |               scrollBottom();
 248 |             } else if (payload.type === 'done') {
 249 |               sessionId = payload.session_id || sessionId;
 250 |               const citations = payload.citations || [];
 251 |               const latency = payload.latency_ms ? Math.round(payload.latency_ms) : 0;
 252 |               const route = payload.route || 'RAG';
 253 | 
 254 |               if (citations.length > 0) {
 255 |                 citationsEl.style.display = 'flex';
 256 |                 let citHtml = `<div class="cit-label">Authoritative Sources (${citations.length})</div>`;
 257 |                 citations.forEach((c, idx) => {
 258 |                   citHtml += `<span class="cit-item" onclick='openCitationDrawer(${JSON.stringify(c)})'>
 259 |                     📑 ${esc(c.policy_name)} v${esc(c.version)} · ${esc(c.section)}
 260 |                   </span>`;
 261 |                 });
 262 |                 citationsEl.innerHTML = citHtml;
 263 |               }
 264 | 
 265 |               feedbackEl.style.display = 'flex';
 266 |               const msgId = payload.message_id || '';
 267 |               feedbackEl.innerHTML = `
 268 |                 <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)">Helpful?</span>
 269 |                 <button class="fb-btn" data-msgid="${msgId}" data-vote="up" onclick="sendFeedback(this)">👍 Yes</button>
 270 |                 <button class="fb-btn" data-msgid="${msgId}" data-vote="down" onclick="sendFeedback(this)">👎 No</button>
 271 |                 <div class="meta-tag">
 272 |                   <span>⚡ ${latency}ms</span>
 273 |                   <span>[${esc(route)}]</span>
 274 |                 </div>`;
 275 |               scrollBottom();
 276 |             }
 277 |           } catch(e) {
 278 |             console.error('SSE parse error', e);
 279 |           }
 280 |         }
 281 |       }
 282 |     }
 283 |   } catch(err) {
 284 |     removeTyping();
 285 |     // Fallback if SSE stream failed
 286 |     try {
 287 |       const fbRes = await fetch('/rag/api/chat', {
 288 |         method: 'POST',
 289 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token() }}' },
 290 |         body: JSON.stringify({ query: q, session_id: sessionId })
 291 |       });
 292 |       const data = await fbRes.json();
 293 |       sessionId = data.session_id || sessionId;
 294 |       addResponse(data);
 295 |     } catch(e2) {
 296 |       addResponse({ answer: 'I encountered an error connecting to the policy engine. Please verify the backend service.', citations: [], fallback: true });
 297 |     }
 298 |   }
 299 | 
 300 |   busy = false;
 301 |   document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = false;
 302 |   input.focus();
 303 | }
 304 | 
 305 | function addResponse(data) {
 306 |   const row = document.createElement('div');
 307 |   row.className = 'msg-row';
 308 |   let citHtml = '';
 309 |   if (data.citations && data.citations.length) {
 310 |     const items = data.citations.map(c =>
 311 |       `<span class="cit-item" onclick='openCitationDrawer(${JSON.stringify(c)})'>
 312 |         📑 ${esc(c.policy_name)} v${esc(c.version)} · ${esc(c.section)}
 313 |       </span>`
 314 |     ).join('');
 315 |     citHtml = `<div class="citations-bar"><div class="cit-label">Sources (${data.citations.length})</div>${items}</div>`;
 316 |   }
 317 |   const msgId = data.message_id || '';
 318 |   const latency = data.latency_ms ? Math.round(data.latency_ms) : 0;
 319 |   row.innerHTML = `
 320 |     <div class="avatar av-sys">§</div>
 321 |     <div class="response-wrap">
 322 |       <div class="response-card">
 323 |         <div class="answer-body ${data.fallback ? 'refused' : ''}">${esc(data.answer)}</div>
 324 |         ${citHtml}
 325 |         <div class="feedback-bar">
 326 |           <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)">Helpful?</span>
 327 |           <button class="fb-btn" data-msgid="${msgId}" data-vote="up" onclick="sendFeedback(this)">👍 Yes</button>
 328 |           <button class="fb-btn" data-msgid="${msgId}" data-vote="down" onclick="sendFeedback(this)">👎 No</button>
 329 |           <div class="meta-tag">
 330 |             <span>⚡ ${latency}ms</span>
 331 |           </div>
 332 |         </div>
 333 |       </div>
 334 |     </div>`;
 335 |   msgs.appendChild(row);
 336 |   scrollBottom();
 337 | }
 338 | 
 339 | async function sendFeedback(btn) {
 340 |   const vote = btn.dataset.vote;
 341 |   const msgId = btn.dataset.msgid;
 342 |   btn.classList.add('voted');
 343 |   btn.closest('.feedback-bar').querySelectorAll('.fb-btn').forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
 344 |   if (msgId) {
 345 |     await fetch('/rag/api/feedback', {
 346 |       method: 'POST',
 347 |       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token() }}' },
 348 |       body: JSON.stringify({ message_id: msgId, vote })
 349 |     });
 350 |   }
 351 |   if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
 352 |     showToast(vote === 'up' ? 'Feedback recorded — thank you!' : 'Feedback recorded — we will refine this answer.');
 353 |   }
 354 | }
 355 | 
 356 | async function clearChat() {
 357 |   if (sessionId) {
 358 |     await fetch('/rag/api/sessions/clear', {
 359 |       method: 'POST',
 360 |       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token() }}' },
 361 |       body: JSON.stringify({ session_id: sessionId })
 362 |     });
 363 |   }
 364 |   sessionId = null;
 365 |   msgs.innerHTML = `<div id="welcomeMsg" style="text-align:center;padding:2rem 1rem">
 366 |     <div style="font-family:var(--font-serif);font-size:20px;font-weight:700">Chat cleared. Ask me anything!</div>
 367 |   </div>`;
 368 | }
 369 | 
 370 | function exportChat() {
 371 |   let text = "Policy Ledger — AI Conversation Log\nExported: " + new Date().toLocaleString() + "\n\n";
 372 |   const rows = msgs.querySelectorAll('.msg-row');
 373 |   rows.forEach(r => {
 374 |     const user = r.querySelector('.bubble-user');
 375 |     const asst = r.querySelector('.answer-body');
 376 |     if (user) text += `User: ${user.textContent.trim()}\n\n`;
 377 |     if (asst) text += `Assistant: ${asst.textContent.trim()}\n\n---\n\n`;
 378 |   });
 379 |   const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
 380 |   const a = document.createElement('a');
 381 |   a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
 382 |   a.download = `policy_chat_${Date.now()}.txt`;
 383 |   a.click();
 384 | }
 385 | </script>
 386 | {% endblock %}

 168 | <script>
 169 | async function generateMOM() {
 170 |   const btn = document.getElementById('generateBtn');
 171 |   const status = document.getElementById('genStatus');
 172 |   const notes = document.getElementById('rawNotes').value.trim();
 173 |   if (!notes) { status.textContent = 'Add notes first.'; return; }
 174 |   btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Generating…'; status.textContent = 'AI is drafting the minutes — this can take a few seconds.';
 175 |   try {
 176 |     const res = await fetch("{{ url_for('meetings.generate_mom_route', meeting_id=meeting.id) }}", {
 177 |       method: 'POST',
 178 |       headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
 179 |       body: 'raw_notes=' + encodeURIComponent(notes)
 180 |     });
 181 |     const d = await res.json();
 182 |     if (d.success) {
 183 |       status.textContent = 'Done. Refreshing…';
 184 |       showToast('Minutes generated successfully');
 185 |       setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 600);
 186 |     } else {
 187 |       status.textContent = d.error || 'Generation failed.';
 188 |     }
 189 |   } catch (e) {
 190 |     status.textContent = 'Error contacting AI service.';
 191 |   } finally {
 192 |     btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '✦ Generate MOM with AI';
 193 |   }
 194 | }
 195 | 
 196 | async function updateStatus(itemId, status) {
 197 |   await fetch(`/action-items/${itemId}/status`, {
 198 |     method: 'POST',
 199 |     headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'},
 200 |     body: 'status=' + encodeURIComponent(status)
 201 |   });
 202 |   showToast('Status updated');
 203 | }
 204 | 
 205 | function copyFollowup() {
 206 |   const el = document.getElementById('followupEmail');
 207 |   el.select();
 208 |   document.execCommand('copy');
 209 |   showToast('Copied to clipboard');
 210 | }
 211 | </script>
 212 | {% endblock %}

  14 | def rate_limit_key_user_or_ip():
  15 |     """Key builder for Flask-Limiter: per-user when authenticated, per-IP otherwise."""
  16 |     from flask_limiter.util import get_remote_address
  17 |     if current_user and current_user.is_authenticated:
  18 |         return f"user:{current_user.id}"
  19 |     return get_remote_address() or "127.0.0.1"

  21 | def extract_json(text: str) -> dict | None:
  22 |     """Shared JSON extraction helper for all AI modules."""
  23 |     import re
  24 |     if not text:
  25 |         return None
  26 |     text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", text.strip())
  27 |     text = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", text)
  28 |     try:
  29 |         obj = json.loads(text)
  30 |         return obj if isinstance(obj, dict) else None
  31 |     except (ValueError, TypeError):
  32 |         pass
  33 |     match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, re.DOTALL)
  34 |     if match:
  35 |         try:
  36 |             obj = json.loads(match.group(0))
  37 |             return obj if isinstance(obj, dict) else None
  38 |         except (ValueError, TypeError):
  39 |             pass
  40 |     return None
  41 | 
  42 | 
  43 | # ---------- Role guards ----------
  44 | def role_required(*roles):
  45 |     """Decorator: abort 403 if current user doesn't have one of the given roles."""
  46 |     def decorator(f):
  47 |         @wraps(f)
  48 |         def wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
  49 |             if not current_user.is_authenticated:
  50 |                 abort(401)
  51 |             if current_user.role not in roles:
  52 |                 abort(403)
  53 |             return f(*args, **kwargs)
  54 |         return wrapped
  55 |     return decorator
  56 |

  60 |     """Write an immutable audit log entry. Safe to call outside a request
  61 |     context too (e.g. from scripts/check_workflow_reminders.py via cron)."""
  62 |     from flask import has_request_context

  65 |         user_id=(current_user.id if in_request and current_user.is_authenticated else None),

  72 |     )

  93 | # ---------- Policy ID generator ----------
  94 | def generate_policy_id() -> str:
  95 |     """
  96 |     Generates sequential IDs like POL-2024-001, POL-2024-002 …
  97 |     Thread-safe because SQLAlchemy commits before we generate the next one.
  98 |     """
  99 |     year = datetime.now().year
 100 |     prefix = f"POL-{year}-"
 101 |     last = (
 102 |         Policy.query
 103 |         .with_for_update()
 104 |         .filter(Policy.policy_id.like(f"{prefix}%"))
 105 |         .order_by(Policy.id.desc())
 106 |         .first()
 107 |     )
 108 |     if last:
 109 |         try:
 110 |             last_num = int(last.policy_id.split("-")[-1])
 111 |         except ValueError:
 112 |             last_num = 0
 113 |     else:
 114 |         last_num = 0
 115 |     return f"{prefix}{(last_num + 1):03d}"

 118 | # ---------- Version bump ----------
 119 | def next_version(current: str, major: bool = False) -> tuple[float, str]:
 120 |     """
 121 |     current = "1.0" → minor bump → (1.1, "v1.1")
 122 |                "1.0" → major bump → (2.0, "v2.0")
 123 |     """
 124 |     try:
 125 |         parts = str(current).split(".")
 126 |         major_v = int(parts[0])
 127 |         minor_v = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
 128 |     except (ValueError, IndexError):
 129 |         major_v, minor_v = 1, 0
 130 | 
 131 |     if major:
 132 |         major_v += 1
 133 |         minor_v = 0
 134 |     else:
 135 |         minor_v += 1
 136 | 
 137 |     num = float(f"{major_v}.{minor_v}")
 138 |     label = f"v{major_v}.{minor_v}"
 139 |     return num, label
 140 |

 142 | # ---------- Diff engine (Phase 3 version comparison) ----------
 143 | def compute_diff(old_text: str, new_text: str) -> dict:
 144 |     """
 145 |     Produces a structured diff between two policy texts.
 146 |     Returns:
 147 |       {
 148 |         "added": [lines],
 149 |         "removed": [lines],
 150 |         "changed": [(old_line, new_line)],
 151 |         "html": "<span class='added'>...</span> ..." (inline HTML for UI),
 152 |         "stats": {"added": n, "removed": n, "changed": n}
 153 |       }
 154 |     """
 155 |     old_lines = old_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
 156 |     new_lines = new_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
 157 | 
 158 |     added, removed, changed, html_parts = [], [], [], []
 159 |     matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, old_lines, new_lines)
 160 | 
 161 |     for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in matcher.get_opcodes():
 162 |         if tag == "equal":
 163 |             for line in old_lines[i1:i2]:
 164 |                 html_parts.append(f'<span class="diff-equal">{_esc(line)}</span>')
 165 |         elif tag == "insert":
 166 |             for line in new_lines[j1:j2]:
 167 |                 added.append(line.rstrip())
 168 |                 html_parts.append(f'<span class="diff-added">+ {_esc(line)}</span>')
 169 |         elif tag == "delete":
 170 |             for line in old_lines[i1:i2]:
 171 |                 removed.append(line.rstrip())
 172 |                 html_parts.append(f'<span class="diff-removed">- {_esc(line)}</span>')
 173 |         elif tag == "replace":
 174 |             for line in old_lines[i1:i2]:
 175 |                 removed.append(line.rstrip())
 176 |                 html_parts.append(f'<span class="diff-removed">- {_esc(line)}</span>')
 177 |             for line in new_lines[j1:j2]:
 178 |                 added.append(line.rstrip())
 179 |                 html_parts.append(f'<span class="diff-added">+ {_esc(line)}</span>')
 180 |             changed.append(("".join(old_lines[i1:i2]), "".join(new_lines[j1:j2])))
 181 | 
 182 |     return {
 183 |         "added": added,
 184 |         "removed": removed,
 185 |         "changed": changed,
 186 |         "html": "".join(html_parts),
 187 |         "stats": {"added": len(added), "removed": len(removed), "changed": len(changed)},
 188 |     }
 189 | 
 190 | 
 191 | def _esc(s: str) -> str:
 192 |     return s.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")
 193 |

 201 | def days_until(d) -> int | None:
 202 |     if d is None:
 203 |         return None
 204 |     today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()
 205 |     return (d - today).days

 208 | # ---------- Meeting code generator (Module 5) ----------
 209 | def generate_meeting_code() -> str:
 210 |     """Sequential codes like MTG-2026-001, MTG-2026-002 …"""
 211 |     from models import Meeting
 212 |     year = datetime.now().year
 213 |     prefix = f"MTG-{year}-"
 214 |     last = (
 215 |         Meeting.query
 216 |         .filter(Meeting.meeting_code.like(f"{prefix}%"))
 217 |         .order_by(Meeting.id.desc())
 218 |         .first()
 219 |     )

 221 |         try:
 222 |             last_num = int(last.meeting_code.split("-")[-1])
 223 |         except ValueError:
 224 |             last_num = 0
 225 |     else:
 226 |         last_num = 0
 227 |     return f"{prefix}{(last_num + 1):03d}"
