 230 | # ---------- ICS calendar export (Module 5 — "Generate Calendar Tasks") ----------
 231 | def _ics_escape(text: str) -> str:
 232 |     return (text or "").replace("\\", "\\\\").replace(",", "\\,").replace(";", "\\;").replace("\n", "\\n")
 233 | 
 234 | 
 235 | def build_action_items_ics(action_items, calendar_name: str = "Policy Ledger Action Items") -> str:
 236 |     """
 237 |     Builds a minimal .ics calendar file (VCALENDAR/VTODO) from a list of
 238 |     MeetingActionItem objects that have a due_date set. No external
 239 |     dependency required — VTODO/VEVENT is plain text per RFC 5545.
 240 |     """
 241 |     now_stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
 242 |     lines = [
 243 |         "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
 244 |         "VERSION:2.0",
 245 |         "PRODID:-//Policy Ledger//Meeting Action Items//EN",
 246 |         f"X-WR-CALNAME:{_ics_escape(calendar_name)}",
 247 |     ]
 248 |     for item in action_items:
 249 |         if not item.due_date:
 250 |             continue
 251 |         due_str = item.due_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
 252 |         uid = f"action-{item.id}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@policyledger"
 253 |         priority_map = {"high": 1, "medium": 5, "low": 9}
 254 |         lines += [
 255 |             "BEGIN:VTODO",
 256 |             f"UID:{uid}",
 257 |             f"DTSTAMP:{now_stamp}",
 258 |             f"DUE;VALUE=DATE:{due_str}",
 259 |             f"SUMMARY:{_ics_escape(item.description[:200])}",
 260 |             f"DESCRIPTION:{_ics_escape('Owner: ' + item.owner_display)}",
 261 |             f"PRIORITY:{priority_map.get(item.priority, 5)}",
 262 |             f"STATUS:{'COMPLETED' if item.status == 'done' else 'NEEDS-ACTION'}",
 263 |             "END:VTODO",
 264 |         ]
 265 |     lines.append("END:VCALENDAR")
 266 |     return "\r\n".join(lines)
 267 | 
 268 | 
 269 | # ---------- PDF export (Search / Module 14 — "give me the whole document") ----------
 270 | def generate_policy_pdf(policy, version):
 271 |     """
 272 |     Renders a policy version as a formatted PDF and returns an in-memory
 273 |     BytesIO ready for send_file(). Uses reportlab (pure Python, no
 274 |     external binary needed). Policy.download_count already existed in the
 275 |     schema for this purpose but nothing populated it before.
 276 |     """
 277 |     import io
 278 |     from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import LETTER
 279 |     from reportlab.lib.units import inch
 280 |     from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
 281 |     from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, HRFlowable
 282 |     from reportlab.lib import colors
 283 |     from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_LEFT
 284 | 
 285 |     buf = io.BytesIO()
 286 |     doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
 287 |         buf, pagesize=LETTER,
 288 |         topMargin=0.85 * inch, bottomMargin=0.85 * inch,
 289 |         leftMargin=0.9 * inch, rightMargin=0.9 * inch,
 290 |         title=policy.title, author="Policy Ledger",
 291 |     )
 292 |     styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
 293 |     title_style = ParagraphStyle("PLTitle", parent=styles["Title"], alignment=TA_LEFT, fontSize=18, spaceAfter=4)
 294 |     meta_style = ParagraphStyle("PLMeta", parent=styles["Normal"], fontSize=9, textColor=colors.HexColor("#5a5a52"))
 295 |     body_style = ParagraphStyle("PLBody", parent=styles["Normal"], fontSize=10.5, leading=15, spaceAfter=8)
 296 | 
 297 |     story = [
 298 |         Paragraph(policy.title, title_style),
 299 |         Paragraph(
 300 |             f"{policy.policy_id} &nbsp;·&nbsp; Version {version.version_label} &nbsp;·&nbsp; "
 301 |             f"Status: {policy.status.replace('_', ' ').title()} &nbsp;·&nbsp; "
 302 |             f"Category: {policy.category.name if policy.category else 'General'}",
 303 |             meta_style,
 304 |         ),
 305 |         Spacer(1, 4),
 306 |         HRFlowable(width="100%", thickness=0.75, color=colors.HexColor("#c9c4b4")),
 307 |         Spacer(1, 12),
 308 |     ]
 309 | 
 310 |     if policy.description:
 311 |         story.append(Paragraph(f"<i>{policy.description}</i>", body_style))
 312 |         story.append(Spacer(1, 6))
 313 | 
 314 |     for para in (version.content or "").split("\n"):
 315 |         para = para.strip()
 316 |         if not para:
 317 |             story.append(Spacer(1, 6))
 318 |             continue
 319 |         safe = para.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")
 320 |         story.append(Paragraph(safe, body_style))
 321 | 
 322 |     story.append(Spacer(1, 18))
 323 |     story.append(HRFlowable(width="100%", thickness=0.5, color=colors.HexColor("#c9c4b4")))
 324 |     story.append(Spacer(1, 6))
 325 |     footer = (f"Effective: {version.effective_date or '—'} &nbsp;·&nbsp; "
 326 |              f"Generated by Policy Ledger on {datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
 327 |     story.append(Paragraph(footer, meta_style))
 328 | 
 329 |     doc.build(story)
 330 |     buf.seek(0)
 331 |     return buf

   1 | """
   2 | whatif_ai.py
   3 | AI engine for Module 25 — Policy Impact Simulator ("What-If" Compliance Checker).
   4 | 
   5 | Unlike the AI Assistant (Module: rag chat), which answers open-ended
   6 | questions conversationally, this module takes a described real-world
   7 | scenario/decision ("I want to expense a personal laptop under $500") and
   8 | returns a *structured verdict* — compliant / not compliant / depends /
   9 | unclear — grounded in the same retrieved policy chunks, with:
  10 | 
  11 |   - the specific policies + sections that apply (citations)
  12 |   - concrete required actions ("Get manager sign-off before purchase")
  13 |   - a confidence score, so low-confidence verdicts are visibly flagged
  14 |     rather than presented with false certainty
  15 |   - an auto-flag for HR review when the scenario is ambiguous or touches
  16 |     a mandatory/critical-priority policy, turning grey-area employee
  17 |     questions into a queue HR can actually act on.
  18 | 
  19 | Reuses the existing embedder / vector store / reranker (same stack as
  20 | rag/chatbot/chat_service.py) so no new indexing pipeline is needed —
  21 | only the final prompt and output shape differ.
  22 | """
  23 | import json
  24 | import re
  25 | 
  26 | from rag.embeddings.embedder import get_embedder
  27 | from rag.vectordb.chroma import get_store
  28 | from rag.reranker.reranker import get_reranker
  29 | from rag.llm_provider import get_llm_provider
  30 | 
  31 | RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD = 0.10
  32 | 
  33 | 
  34 | from utils import extract_json
  35 | 
  36 | 
  37 | VERDICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are a corporate compliance decision-support assistant. An employee \
  38 | describes a real-world scenario or thing they want to do. You are given excerpts from the \
  39 | company's ACTIVE policies that are most relevant to it. Decide whether the scenario is allowed.
  40 | 
  41 | Respond with ONLY a single valid JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary:
  42 | {
  43 |   "verdict": "compliant" | "not_compliant" | "depends" | "unclear",
  44 |   "confidence": <integer 0-100>,
  45 |   "explanation": "2-4 sentence plain-language explanation of the verdict, written directly to the employee",
  46 |   "required_actions": ["concrete next step, e.g. 'Get written manager approval before booking travel'", "..."],
  47 |   "applicable_sections": ["short label of which excerpt/section the verdict rests on, e.g. 'Remote Work Policy - Section 3'", "..."]
  48 | }
  49 | 
  50 | Rules:
  51 | - "compliant": clearly allowed as described, no special steps needed beyond normal process.
  52 | - "not_compliant": clearly against policy as described.
  53 | - "depends": allowed only under specific conditions (e.g. approval, threshold, duration) — explain the condition.
  54 | - "unclear": the provided policy excerpts don't clearly cover this scenario. Use confidence <= 40 in this case.
  55 | - Base the verdict strictly on the provided excerpts. Do not invent policy content that isn't there.
  56 | - If nothing relevant was provided at all, return verdict "unclear" with confidence 0.
  57 | """
  58 | 
  59 | 
  60 | def _heuristic_verdict(scenario: str, chunks: list[dict]) -> dict:
  61 |     """Zero-LLM fallback: no verdict claim, just surfaces the most relevant
  62 |     excerpts so the employee/HR still gets something actionable."""
  63 |     if not chunks:
  64 |         return {
  65 |             "verdict": "unclear", "confidence": 0,
  66 |             "explanation": "I couldn't find any policy content relevant to this scenario. "
  67 |                            "Please check with HR directly, or configure an LLM provider for full analysis.",
  68 |             "required_actions": ["Ask HR / your manager directly."],
  69 |             "applicable_sections": [],
  70 |         }
  71 |     top = chunks[0]
  72 |     return {
  73 |         "verdict": "unclear", "confidence": 20,
  74 |         "explanation": (f"The closest matching policy content is from '{top.get('policy_name', 'a policy')}' "
  75 |                         f"(Section: {top.get('section', 'General')}), but automatic verdict generation is "
  76 |                         "unavailable right now (no LLM configured). Please review the cited section yourself "
  77 |                         "or ask HR to confirm."),
  78 |         "required_actions": ["Confirm with HR before proceeding."],
  79 |         "applicable_sections": [f"{top.get('policy_name', 'Policy')} - {top.get('section', 'General')}"],
  80 |     }
  81 | 
  82 | 
  83 | def evaluate_scenario(scenario: str, user_role: str = "employee", user_department: str = "",
  84 |                       top_k_retrieve: int = 20, top_k_rerank: int = 6) -> dict:
  85 |     """
  86 |     Full pipeline: scenario -> embed -> retrieve -> rerank -> structured verdict.
  87 | 
  88 |     Returns:
  89 |     {
  90 |         "verdict": str, "confidence": int, "explanation": str,
  91 |         "required_actions": list[str],
  92 |         "citations": list[dict],   # same shape as chat citations (policy_name, version, section, page, policy_id)
  93 |         "flagged_for_hr": bool,
  94 |         "chunks_used": int,
  95 |     }
  96 |     """
  97 |     scenario = (scenario or "").strip()
  98 |     if not scenario:
  99 |         return {"verdict": "unclear", "confidence": 0, "explanation": "No scenario provided.",
 100 |                "required_actions": [], "citations": [], "flagged_for_hr": False, "chunks_used": 0}
 101 | 
 102 |     embedder = get_embedder()
 103 |     store = get_store()
 104 |     reranker = get_reranker()
 105 |     llm = get_llm_provider()
 106 | 
 107 |     allowed_depts = None
 108 |     if user_role == "employee" and user_department:
 109 |         allowed_depts = [user_department, ""]
 110 | 
 111 |     hits = []
 112 |     try:
 113 |         q_vec = embedder.embed_query(scenario)
 114 |         try:
 115 |             hits = store.search(
 116 |                 query_embedding=q_vec, query_text=scenario, top_k=top_k_retrieve,
 117 |                 active_only=True, allowed_departments=allowed_depts
 118 |             )
 119 |         except TypeError:
 120 |             hits = store.search(embedding=q_vec, filters={}, top_k=top_k_retrieve)
 121 |     except Exception:
 122 |         try:
 123 |             from rag.retrieval.hybrid import HybridRetriever
 124 |             hits = HybridRetriever().search(scenario, top_k=top_k_retrieve)
 125 |         except Exception:
 126 |             hits = []
 127 | 
 128 |     hits = [h for h in hits if h.get("score", 0) >= RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD or h.get("hybrid_score", 0) >= RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD]
 129 |     
 130 |     if hasattr(reranker, "rerank"):
 131 |         top_chunks = reranker.rerank(scenario, hits, top_k=top_k_rerank) if hits else []
 132 |     else:
 133 |         top_chunks = reranker.rank(scenario, hits, top_k=top_k_rerank) if hits else []
 134 | 
 135 |     citations = []
 136 |     seen = set()
 137 |     for c in top_chunks:
 138 |         key = (c.get("policy_name"), c.get("version"), c.get("section"))
 139 |         if key in seen:
 140 |             continue
 141 |         seen.add(key)
 142 |         citations.append({
 143 |             "policy_name": c.get("policy_name", "Unknown"), "version": c.get("version", "N/A"),
 144 |             "section": c.get("section", "General"), "page": c.get("page", "N/A"),
 145 |             "policy_id": c.get("policy_id", ""),
 146 |             "relevance_score": round(c.get("rerank_score", c.get("score", 0)), 3),
 147 |         })
 148 | 
 149 |     if not top_chunks:
 150 |         result = _heuristic_verdict(scenario, top_chunks)
 151 |     else:
 152 |         excerpts = "\n\n---\n\n".join(
 153 |             f"[{c.get('policy_name')} — {c.get('section', 'General')}]\n{c.get('text', '')[:1200]}"
 154 |             for c in top_chunks
 155 |         )
 156 |         user_prompt = f"SCENARIO: {scenario}\n\nPOLICY EXCERPTS:\n\n{excerpts}\n\nQUESTION: {scenario}\n\nProduce the JSON verdict now."
 157 |         raw_resp = None
 158 |         raw = ""
 159 |         try:
 160 |             prompt_msgs = [
 161 |                 {"role": "system", "content": VERDICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
 162 |                 {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt},
 163 |             ]
 164 |             raw_resp = llm.generate(prompt_msgs)
 165 |             raw = raw_resp.text
 166 |             
 167 |             if getattr(raw_resp, "fallback", False):
 168 |                 parsed = {
 169 |                     "verdict": "depends",
 170 |                     "confidence": 40,
 171 |                     "explanation": raw if raw != "I couldn't find this information in the available policies." else "The closest matching policy content does not clearly authorize or prohibit this scenario. Please check with HR.",
 172 |                     "required_actions": ["Review the policy manually or ask HR."],
 173 |                     "applicable_sections": [f"{top_chunks[0].get('policy_name', 'Policy')} - {top_chunks[0].get('section', 'General')}"]
 174 |                 }
 175 |             else:
 176 |                 parsed = extract_json(raw)
 177 |                 if parsed and (int(parsed.get("confidence", 0) or 0) < 55 or parsed.get("verdict") in ("depends", "unclear")):
 178 |                     # Escalate to secondary model due to ambiguity
 179 |                     from rag.llm_provider import CascadeProvider
 180 |                     kwargs = {"use_secondary": True} if isinstance(llm, CascadeProvider) else {}
 181 |                     raw_resp = llm.generate(prompt_msgs, **kwargs)
 182 |                     raw = raw_resp.text
 183 |                     parsed = extract_json(raw)
 184 |         except Exception as exc:
 185 |             import logging
 186 |             logging.warning(f"[whatif_ai] LLM error: {exc}")
 187 |             raw = ""
 188 |             parsed = None
 189 |             raw_resp = None
 190 |             
 191 |         if raw_resp is None or (not getattr(raw_resp, "fallback", False) and (not parsed or "I couldn't find this information" in (raw or ""))):
 192 |             result = _heuristic_verdict(scenario, top_chunks)
 193 |         else:
 194 |             result = {
 195 |                 "verdict": parsed.get("verdict") if parsed.get("verdict") in
 196 |                            ("compliant", "not_compliant", "depends", "unclear") else "unclear",
 197 |                 "confidence": max(0, min(100, int(parsed.get("confidence", 0) or 0))),
 198 |                 "explanation": str(parsed.get("explanation", "") or "").strip() or "No explanation generated.",
 199 |                 "required_actions": [str(a) for a in (parsed.get("required_actions") or [])],
 200 |                 "applicable_sections": [str(a) for a in (parsed.get("applicable_sections") or [])],
 201 |             }
 202 | 
 203 |     flagged = (
 204 |         result["verdict"] in ("depends", "unclear") or
 205 |         result.get("confidence", 0) < 55 or
 206 |         result["verdict"] == "not_compliant"
 207 |     )
 208 | 
 209 |     return {
 210 |         "verdict": result["verdict"],
 211 |         "confidence": result.get("confidence", 0),
 212 |         "explanation": result["explanation"],
 213 |         "required_actions": result.get("required_actions", []),
 214 |         "citations": citations,
 215 |         "flagged_for_hr": flagged,
 216 |         "chunks_used": len(top_chunks),
 217 |     }

   1 | """
   2 | workflow_engine.py
   3 | Module 8: Workflow Automation — engine functions.
   4 | 
   5 | This sits alongside (not replacing) the original simple 3-stage approval
   6 | flow in blueprints/admin.py. It only activates once at least one
   7 | WorkflowTemplate exists in the system; policy_detail.html decides which
   8 | "Submit for Review" button to show based on that.
   9 | 
  10 | Key ideas:
  11 |   - A WorkflowTemplate is chosen for a policy based on category + priority
  12 |     conditions ("conditional workflow").
  13 |   - Each WorkflowStage can have multiple approvers (WorkflowStageApprover);
  14 |     approval_mode "any" clears the stage on the first approval, "all"
  15 |     requires every assigned approver to approve ("parallel approval").
  16 |   - SLA timers + escalation + reminders are handled by check_reminders_and_escalations(),
  17 |     callable from an admin button or a cron/Task Scheduler job

  28 | def select_template(policy):
  29 |     """
  30 |     Conditional workflow selection: prefer a template whose category+priority
  31 |     conditions match this policy; fall back to the system default template.
  32 |     """
  33 |     candidates = WorkflowTemplate.query.filter_by(is_active=True).all()
  34 |     specific = [t for t in candidates if t.category_id and t.matches(policy)]
  35 |     if specific:
  36 |         return specific[0]
  37 |     generic_matches = [t for t in candidates if not t.category_id and t.matches(policy)]
  38 |     if generic_matches:
  39 |         return generic_matches[0]
  40 |     defaults = [t for t in candidates if t.is_default]
  41 |     return defaults[0] if defaults else None
  42 | 
  43 | 
  44 | def _notify_stage_approvers(stage_instance, policy):
  45 |     actions = WorkflowApprovalAction.query.filter_by(
  46 |         stage_instance_id=stage_instance.id, status=WorkflowStageStatus.PENDING).all()
  47 |     notified_user_ids = set()
  48 |     for action in actions:
  49 |         if action.approver_type == "user" and action.assigned_user_id:
  50 |             notified_user_ids.add(action.assigned_user_id)
  51 |         elif action.approver_type == "role" and action.role:
  52 |             for u in User.query.filter_by(role=action.role, is_active=True).all():
  53 |                 notified_user_ids.add(u.id)
  54 |     for uid in notified_user_ids:
  55 |         notify_user(uid, NotificationType.APPROVAL_NEEDED,
  56 |                    f"Approval needed: {policy.title} — {stage_instance.name}",
  57 |                    link=f"/admin/policies/{policy.id}")

  60 | def start_workflow(policy, version, template, started_by=None):
  61 |     """
  62 |     Instantiates all stages from `template` for this policy/version.
  63 |     Stage 1 becomes PENDING immediately (with SLA timer started); the rest
  64 |     start WAITING. Returns the list of created WorkflowStageInstance rows.
  65 |     """
  66 |     # Clear any previous run for this version (e.g. resubmission after rejection)
  67 |     WorkflowStageInstance.query.filter_by(version_id=version.id).delete()
  68 |     db.session.flush()
  69 | 
  70 |     instances = []
  71 |     for stage in template.stages:
  72 |         instance = WorkflowStageInstance(
  73 |             policy_id=policy.id, version_id=version.id, template_id=template.id,
  74 |             name=stage.name, order=stage.order, approval_mode=stage.approval_mode,
  75 |             sla_hours=stage.sla_hours,
  76 |             status=WorkflowStageStatus.WAITING,
  77 |         )
  78 |         db.session.add(instance)
  79 |         db.session.flush()
  80 | 
  81 |         for approver in stage.approvers:
  82 |             db.session.add(WorkflowApprovalAction(
  83 |                 stage_instance_id=instance.id, approver_type=approver.approver_type,
  84 |                 role=approver.role, assigned_user_id=approver.user_id,
  85 |                 status=WorkflowStageStatus.PENDING,
  86 |             ))
  87 |         instances.append(instance)
  88 | 
  89 |     if instances:
  90 |         first = min(instances, key=lambda i: i.order)
  91 |         first.status = WorkflowStageStatus.PENDING
  92 |         if first.sla_hours:
  93 |             first.sla_due_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=first.sla_hours)
  94 | 
  95 |     db.session.commit()
  96 | 
  97 |     if instances:
  98 |         _notify_stage_approvers(min(instances, key=lambda i: i.order), policy)
  99 |         audit("workflow.start", "policy", policy.id, {"template": template.name, "stages": len(instances)})
 100 | 
 101 |     return instances

 103 | 
 104 | def _finish_stage(stage_instance, final_status):
 105 |     stage_instance.status = final_status
 106 |     stage_instance.completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 107 |     # Any still-pending sibling actions in an "any" group get marked skipped
 108 |     for action in stage_instance.actions:
 109 |         if action.status == WorkflowStageStatus.PENDING:
 110 |             action.status = WorkflowStageStatus.SKIPPED

 112 | 
 113 | def record_action(stage_instance, actor, decision: str, comment: str = ""):
 114 |     """
 115 |     `decision` is "approve" or "reject". Returns a dict describing what
 116 |     happened: {stage_completed, workflow_status, next_stage} for the caller
 117 |     to flash/notify appropriately.
 118 |     """
 119 |     my_action = next((a for a in stage_instance.actions
 120 |                       if a.status == WorkflowStageStatus.PENDING and a.user_can_act(actor)), None)
 121 |     if not my_action:
 122 |         return {"error": "You are not an eligible approver for this stage, or it's already been acted on."}
 123 | 
 124 |     my_action.actor_id = actor.id
 125 |     my_action.comment = comment
 126 |     my_action.acted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 127 |     my_action.status = WorkflowStageStatus.APPROVED if decision == "approve" else WorkflowStageStatus.REJECTED
 128 | 
 129 |     policy = stage_instance.policy
 130 |     result = {"stage_completed": False, "workflow_status": None, "next_stage": None}
 131 | 
 132 |     if decision == "reject":
 133 |         _finish_stage(stage_instance, WorkflowStageStatus.REJECTED)
 134 |         policy.status = PolicyStatus.REJECTED
 135 |         stage_instance.version.status = "rejected"
 136 |         result.update(stage_completed=True, workflow_status=WorkflowInstanceStatus.REJECTED)
 137 |         db.session.commit()
 138 |         audit("workflow.reject", "policy", policy.id, {"stage": stage_instance.name})
 139 |         return result
 140 | 
 141 |     # decision == "approve" — check whether the stage is now cleared
 142 |     remaining = [a for a in stage_instance.actions if a.status == WorkflowStageStatus.PENDING]
 143 |     approved_count = sum(1 for a in stage_instance.actions if a.status == WorkflowStageStatus.APPROVED)
 144 |     stage_cleared = (
 145 |         (stage_instance.approval_mode == WorkflowApprovalMode.ANY and approved_count >= 1) or
 146 |         (stage_instance.approval_mode == WorkflowApprovalMode.ALL and not remaining)
 147 |     )
 148 | 
 149 |     if not stage_cleared:
 150 |         db.session.commit()
 151 |         audit("workflow.partial_approve", "policy", policy.id, {"stage": stage_instance.name})
 152 |         return result
 153 | 
 154 |     _finish_stage(stage_instance, WorkflowStageStatus.APPROVED)
 155 |     result["stage_completed"] = True
 156 | 
 157 |     # Activate next stage, if any
 158 |     next_stage = (WorkflowStageInstance.query
 159 |                  .filter_by(policy_id=policy.id, version_id=stage_instance.version_id)
 160 |                  .filter(WorkflowStageInstance.order > stage_instance.order)
 161 |                  .order_by(WorkflowStageInstance.order.asc()).first())
 162 | 
 163 |     if next_stage:
 164 |         next_stage.status = WorkflowStageStatus.PENDING
 165 |         if next_stage.sla_hours:
 166 |             next_stage.sla_due_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=next_stage.sla_hours)
 167 |         result["next_stage"] = next_stage.name
 168 |         result["workflow_status"] = WorkflowInstanceStatus.IN_PROGRESS
 169 |         db.session.commit()
 170 |         _notify_stage_approvers(next_stage, policy)
 171 |     else:
 172 |         # All stages cleared — publish
 173 |         policy.status = PolicyStatus.ACTIVE
 174 |         version = stage_instance.version
 175 |         version.status = "approved"
 176 |         version.approved_by_id = actor.id
 177 |         version.approved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 178 |         result["workflow_status"] = WorkflowInstanceStatus.APPROVED
 179 |         db.session.commit()
 180 | 
 181 |     audit("workflow.approve", "policy", policy.id, {"stage": stage_instance.name})
 182 |     return result
 183 | 
 184 | 
 185 | # ================================================================
 186 | # SLA reminders + escalation (Module 8 — "Auto reminders", "Escalation", "SLA timers")
 187 | # ================================================================
 188 | def check_reminders_and_escalations(reminder_lead_hours: int = 24):
 189 |     """
 190 |     Call periodically (admin button, or scripts/check_workflow_reminders.py via
 191 |     cron/Task Scheduler). For every PENDING stage instance:
 192 |       - if within `reminder_lead_hours` of its SLA deadline and no reminder sent yet,
 193 |         notify the pending approvers.
 194 |       - if past its SLA deadline and not yet escalated, mark escalated and notify
 195 |         all Admins (the escalation path, since this app has no per-user "manager" link).
 196 |     Returns a summary dict for display.
 197 |     """
 198 |     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 199 |     reminders_sent, escalations_made = 0, 0
 200 | 
 201 |     pending = WorkflowStageInstance.query.filter_by(status=WorkflowStageStatus.PENDING).filter(
 202 |         WorkflowStageInstance.sla_due_at.isnot(None)).all()
 203 | 
 204 |     for stage in pending:
 205 |         policy = stage.policy
 206 |         if stage.is_overdue and not stage.escalated:
 207 |             stage.escalated = True
 208 |             stage.escalated_at = now
 209 |             for admin in User.query.filter_by(role=UserRole.ADMIN, is_active=True).all():
 210 |                 notify_user(admin.id, NotificationType.APPROVAL_NEEDED,
 211 |                            f"⚠ Escalated: {policy.title} — {stage.name} is overdue",
 212 |                            link=f"/admin/policies/{policy.id}")
 213 |             audit("workflow.escalate", "policy", policy.id, {"stage": stage.name}, commit=False)
 214 |             escalations_made += 1
 215 |         elif not stage.escalated and not stage.reminder_sent_at:
 216 |             sla_aware = stage.sla_due_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if stage.sla_due_at.tzinfo is None else stage.sla_due_at
 217 |             hours_left = (sla_aware - now).total_seconds() / 3600
 218 |             if 0 < hours_left <= reminder_lead_hours:
 219 |                 stage.reminder_sent_at = now
 220 |                 _notify_stage_approvers(stage, policy)
 221 |                 reminders_sent += 1
 222 | 
 223 |     db.session.commit()
 224 |     return {"reminders_sent": reminders_sent, "escalations_made": escalations_made, "checked": len(pending)}
